title: Self-Improving Video-to-Action Models
title_zh: 自改进视频到动作模型

paragraphs.en: Video generative models are an emerging tool for embodied agents: they can serve as scalable visual planners, generating videos that depict how to complete previously unseen tasks. However, executing these plans typically requires a video-to-action or “inverse dynamics” model trained on large, human-collected video-action datasets, severely limiting scalability. We introduce Mirror , a self-supervised approach that learns video-to-action mappings through environment interactions, without prior action data or hand-crafted rewards. Mirror learns by attempting to follow a visual plan by executing its best guess of the underlying actions in the environment. Mirror then trains on the resulting video-action pairs, incrementally self-improving and following the visual planner more closely. Across Atari, OGBench, and DeepMind Control, Mirror outperforms leading learning-from-observation methods with learned video plans, and achieves near-expert performance with oracle plans. On Minecraft BASALT, it outperforms methods with access to expert actions or hand-engineered task knowledge. In Minecraft survival, it is the first method to acquire an iron pickaxe through self-improvement alone, without rewards or expert action labels. In the offline setting, with expert action labels but no environment interaction, it sets a new state of the art in obtaining diamonds. Our results suggest that advances in video models can translate into increasingly capable agents without a corresponding need for hand-crafted rewards or large collections of expert action data. Please find video and other results on our website.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成模型是具身智能体的一种新兴工具：它们可以作为可扩展的视觉规划器，生成描绘如何完成先前未见任务的规划视频。 然而，执行这些规划通常需要一个在大型人工收集的视频-动作数据集上训练的视频到动作（即“逆动力学”）模型，这严重限制了可扩展性。 我们提出 Mirror，这是一种自监督方法，它通过与环境交互来学习视频到动作的映射，无需先验动作数据或手工设计的奖励。 Mirror 的学习方式是：尝试通过在环境中执行其对底层动作的最佳猜测来遵循视觉规划。 随后 Mirror 在由此产生的视频-动作对上进行训练，逐步自我改进，并更加紧密地遵循视觉规划器。 在 Atari、OGBench 和 DeepMind Control 上，Mirror 使用学习到的视频规划时优于领先的从观察学习方法，使用 oracle 规划时达到接近专家的性能。 在 Minecraft BASALT 上，它优于可以访问专家动作或手工设计任务知识的方法。 在 Minecraft 生存任务中，它是首个仅通过自我改进、无需奖励或专家动作标签就获得铁镐的方法。 在离线设置下，即拥有专家动作标签但没有环境交互时，它在获取钻石方面创造了新的最先进水平。 我们的结果表明，视频模型的进步可以转化为能力日益增强的智能体，而无需相应的手工设计奖励或大量专家动作数据收集。 视频及其他结果请参见我们的网站。

paragraphs.en: Video models are emerging as scalable learners of the physical world. Trained on vast collections of unstructured web video, they absorb knowledge about objects, environments, human behavior, and how tasks unfold over time. Recent work has begun to harness this knowledge for robot control by using video models as visual planners (e.g., Du et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Rhoda, 2026 ). Given past frames and optional task conditioning, these models generate a video depicting how the task could be completed. An embodiment-specific video-to-action (V2A) or “inverse dynamics” model then translates the generated visual trajectory into robot actions. This has yielded impressive generalization across unseen tasks, objects, environments, and embodiments.
paragraphs.zh: 视频模型正在成为物理世界的可扩展学习者。 通过在海量非结构化网络视频集合上进行训练，它们吸收了关于物体、环境、人类行为以及任务如何随时间展开的知识。 近期的工作已经开始利用这些知识来实现机器人控制，方法是将视频模型用作视觉规划器（例如 Du et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2025；Ye et al., 2026；Rhoda, 2026）。 给定过去的帧和可选的任务条件，这些模型会生成一段视频，描绘任务可能如何被完成。 然后由一个针对特定本体（embodiment）的视频到动作（V2A）或“逆动力学”模型，将生成的视觉轨迹转换为机器人动作。 这种方法已经在未见过的任务、物体、环境和本体上取得了令人印象深刻的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: However, training the V2A model still requires significant amounts of expert-collected, paired video-action data from oracle motion planners or human teleoperation. Moreover, agents cannot easily generate such video-action data by rolling out random policies in the environment, as critical environment transitions—such as executing a robot grasp or crafting a diamond pickaxe in Minecraft—are unreachable by a random policy. Today, video planners thus inherit the same scalability bottleneck as video-language-action models: a reliance on expensive expert teleoperation data.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，训练 V2A 模型仍然需要大量由专家收集的、来自最优运动规划器或人类遥操作的成对视频-动作数据。 此外，智能体无法通过在环境中执行随机策略来轻松生成此类视频-动作数据，因为关键的环境转换——例如执行机器人抓取或在 Minecraft 中制作钻石镐——是随机策略无法达到的。 因此，如今的视频规划器继承了与视频-语言-动作模型相同的可扩展性瓶颈：依赖于昂贵的专家遥操作数据。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce Mirror , a fully self-supervised method for learning to execute the policy encoded by a video model only by interacting with the world, without any expert video-action data. We assume access to an expert video planner that, given the current agent observation, can generate an expert-level visual plan. Under this assumption, we show that no further expert action supervision or hand-crafted rewards are necessary to achieve expert-level performance. Mirror thus represents a bet on the continued scaling of video models: as visual planners improve, their capabilities can be translated into actions without a corresponding increase in expert action data.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出 Mirror，这是一种完全自监督的方法，仅通过与世界的交互来学习执行视频模型所编码的策略，无需任何专家视频-动作数据。 我们假设可以访问一个专家视频规划器，它在给定当前智能体观测的情况下，能够生成专家级的视觉规划。 在这一假设下，我们表明无需进一步的专家动作监督或手工设计的奖励即可达到专家级性能。 因此，Mirror 代表了对视频模型持续扩展的一种押注：随着视觉规划器的改进，其能力可以转化为动作，而无需相应增加专家动作数据。

sents.en: In this paper, we introduce Mirror , a fully self-supervised method for learning to execute the policy encoded by a video model only by interacting with the world, without any expert video-action data.
sents.zh: 本文提出 Mirror，这是一种完全自监督的方法，仅通过与世界的交互来学习执行视频模型所编码的策略，无需任何专家视频-动作数据。

sents.en: We assume access to an expert video planner that, given the current agent observation, can generate an expert-level visual plan.
sents.zh: 我们假设可以访问一个专家视频规划器，它在给定当前智能体观测的情况下，能够生成专家级的视觉规划。

sents.en: Under this assumption, we show that no further expert action supervision or hand-crafted rewards are necessary to achieve expert-level performance.
sents.zh: 在这一假设下，我们表明无需进一步的专家动作监督或手工设计的奖励即可达到专家级性能。

sents.en: Mirror thus represents a bet on the continued scaling of video models: as visual planners improve, their capabilities can be translated into actions without a corresponding increase in expert action data.
sents.zh: 因此，Mirror 代表了对视频模型持续扩展的一种押注：随着视觉规划器的改进，其能力可以转化为动作，而无需相应增加专家动作数据。

paragraphs.en: Our key idea is to let a randomly initialized video-to-action model self-improve against the expert video planner. Given the current agent state, we query the planner to generate a video plan. The current video-to-action model then predicts the corresponding actions and the agent executes them in the environment. Interactions produce new paired video-action data, which is used to improve the video-to-action model. Critically, this data is not random but concentrated at the frontier of the agent’s current capability to follow the video plan. Repeating this process allows the agent to follow progressively more of the plan until it faithfully reproduces the planner’s behavior. Mirror does not require rewards, privileged state information, verifiers, or trajectory filtering. Furthermore, we show that our self-improving approach can outperform training on expert actions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心思路是让一个随机初始化的视频到动作模型对照专家视频规划器进行自我改进。 给定当前的智能体状态，我们查询规划器以生成视频规划。 当前的视频到动作模型随后预测相应的动作，智能体在环境中执行这些动作。 交互产生新的视频-动作配对数据，用于改进视频到动作模型。 关键在于，这些数据并非随机，而是集中在智能体当前遵循视频规划能力的前沿。 重复这一过程使智能体能够逐步遵循越来越多的规划，直到它忠实地复现规划器的行为。 Mirror 不需要奖励、特权状态信息、验证器或轨迹过滤。 此外，我们表明这种自我改进方法可以超越在专家动作上的训练。

sents.zh: 我们的核心思路是让一个随机初始化的视频到动作模型对照专家视频规划器进行自我改进。

sents.zh: 关键在于，这些数据并非随机，而是集中在智能体当前遵循视频规划能力的前沿。

sents.zh: 重复这一过程使智能体能够逐步遵循越来越多的规划，直到它忠实地复现规划器的行为。

sents.en: Mirror does not require rewards, privileged state information, verifiers, or trajectory filtering.
sents.zh: Mirror 不需要奖励、特权状态信息、验证器或轨迹过滤。

sents.en: Furthermore, we show that our self-improving approach can outperform training on expert actions.
sents.zh: 此外，我们表明这种自我改进方法可以超越在专家动作上的训练。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Mirror in two settings: (i) the Minecraft survival challenge ( Guss et al., 2019 ) and Minecraft BASALT competition tasks ( Shah et al., 2021 ) ; and (ii) standard decision-making benchmarks, including Atari ( Bellemare et al., 2013 ) , OGBench ( Park et al., 2025a ) , and DeepMind Control ( Tassa et al., 2018 ) . To the best of our knowledge, no prior method without either hand-crafted rewards or expert action labels achieves non-zero success on these Minecraft tasks. Mirror outperforms baselines, including those with privileged information, and further exploits the emergent in-context learning of large video models, improving faster than a baseline that cannot leverage context across attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两种设置下评估 Mirror：(i) Minecraft 生存挑战（Guss et al., 2019）与 Minecraft BASALT 竞赛任务（Shah et al., 2021）；以及 (ii) 标准决策基准，包括 Atari（Bellemare et al., 2013）、OGBench（Park et al., 2025a）和 DeepMind Control（Tassa et al., 2018）。 据我们所知，没有任何先前方法在不依赖手工设计奖励或专家动作标签的情况下，在这些 Minecraft 任务上取得非零成功率。 Mirror 优于包括拥有特权信息在内的各基线方法，并进一步利用了大型视频模型涌现的上下文学习能力，相比无法跨尝试利用上下文的基线，其提升速度更快。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: Mirror , a scalable agent that learns long-horizon tasks by self-improving against a pre-trained video planner, without task rewards or expert video-action data.
paragraphs.zh: Mirror，一个可扩展的智能体，它通过针对预训练视频规划器进行自我改进来学习长时程任务，无需任务奖励或专家视频-动作数据。

paragraphs.en: Mirror is the first method to achieve non-zero success rates on the BASALT Minecraft suite without expert video-action data or hard-coded actions.

paragraphs.en: On a suite of 24 common RL tasks, Mirror outperforms baselines using a generative video planner, and, when paired with an oracle video planner, nearly matches expert returns.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个包含 24 个常见强化学习任务的测试套件上，Mirror 的表现优于使用生成式视频规划器的基线方法，并且在与 oracle 视频规划器配对时，几乎达到了专家回报水平。

paragraphs.en: Video planners. A nascent line of work leverages video generative models to generate a visual plan of how a given task should be solved, and then translates it into actions ( Du et al., 2023 ; Ko et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024a ; Luo & Du, 2024 ; Bharadhwaj et al., 2024 ) . As video models can be pre-trained on web-scale data, robots can inherit impressive generalization capabilities ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . However, translating videos into robot actions generally requires training on paired video-action data ( Du et al., 2023 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Pai et al., 2025 ) . Our agent learns to act from video and self-play in an interactive environment alone, reaching imagined futures without a single action label.

paragraphs.en: Learning from demonstrations. We focus on imitation from observation, where an agent learns from expert observations without action labels or task rewards ( Torabi et al., 2018 ) . Adversarial approaches match expert observation distributions through learned discriminator rewards ( Torabi et al., 2019 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Giammarino et al., 2024 ) , but can be unstable and sensitive to hyperparameters ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . Iterative behavioral cloning alternates between training a V2A model on the agent’s own experience and imitating V2A-labeled demonstrations ( Torabi et al., 2018 ) , but collecting informative transitions remains an exploration challenge on long-horizon tasks ( Schmidt & Jiang, 2024 ) . ASH ( Schneider et al., 2026 ) applied a similar recipe to long-horizon games such as Pokémon and Zelda, training an inverse dynamics model on the agent’s own trajectories to pseudo-label internet gameplay videos. Latent-action approaches such as LAPO and LAPA still ground their latent actions with action labels or rewards ( Schmidt & Jiang, 2024 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . Mirror instead uses a video planner to guide exploration, collecting V2A training data without action labels, rewards, or adversarial optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 从示范中学习。 我们关注从观察中模仿，即智能体在没有动作标签或任务奖励的情况下从专家观察中学习（Torabi et al., 2018）。 对抗性方法通过学习到的判别器奖励来匹配专家观察分布（Torabi et al., 2019；Liu et al., 2023；Giammarino et al., 2024），但可能不稳定且对超参数敏感（Huang et al., 2024）。 迭代行为克隆在基于智能体自身经验训练 V2A 模型与模仿经 V2A 标注的示范之间交替进行（Torabi et al., 2018），但在长时程任务上收集有信息量的转移仍然是一个探索难题（Schmidt & Jiang, 2024）。 ASH（Schneider et al., 2026）将类似的方案应用于宝可梦和塞尔达等长时程游戏，在智能体自身轨迹上训练逆动力学模型，以为互联网游戏视频提供伪标签。 LAPO 和 LAPA 等潜动作方法仍需要依靠动作标签或奖励来确定其潜动作的基础（Schmidt & Jiang, 2024；Ye et al., 2025）。 Mirror 则使用视频规划器来引导探索，在无需动作标签、奖励或对抗性优化的情况下收集 V2A 训练数据。

paragraphs.en: Minecraft agents. Minecraft has become a standard benchmark for long-horizon decision making, ranging from the fuzzy objectives of BASALT ( Shah et al., 2021 ) to the canonical MineRL challenges ( Guss et al., 2019 ) . Existing agents rely on some combination of expert action demonstrations and hand-designed rewards. For example, VPT ( Baker et al., 2022 ) trains a behavioral cloning (BC) policy using about 2,000 hours of action-labeled gameplay recordings from paid contractors, then fine-tunes the policy with about 230,000 hours of online RL. While Dreamer V3 ( Hafner et al., 2025a ) trains a Minecraft RL agent with only 1,400 hours of online RL, they simplify parts of the Minecraft action space and still require hand-designed reward. Dreamer V4 ( Hafner et al., 2025b ) likewise uses reward, and also requires expert actions to train a video world model. Pan-4B ( Pantograph, 2026 ) trains a goal-conditioned RL policy on 500k hours of internet video, yet still post-trains on 2,000 hours of expert action labels. To make long-horizon tasks more tractable, many works improve upon Minecraft policies with language models. MineDojo ( Fan et al., 2022 ) trains PPO agents on shaped rewards and a learned video-language critic, while STEVE-1 ( Lifshitz et al., 2023 ) , DEPS ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , and JARVIS-1 ( Wang et al., 2024 ) use language-based planning.
paragraphs.zh: Minecraft 智能体。 Minecraft 已成为长程决策的标准基准，从 BASALT（Shah 等，2021）的模糊目标到经典的 MineRL 挑战（Guss 等，2019）皆是如此。 现有的智能体依赖于专家动作演示和手工设计奖励的某种组合。 例如，VPT（Baker 等，2022）使用约 2000 小时来自付费承包商、带动作标注的游戏录像训练行为克隆（BC）策略，然后用约 230,000 小时的在线 RL 对该策略进行微调。 虽然 Dreamer V3（Hafner 等，2025a）仅用 1400 小时的在线 RL 就训练出了 Minecraft RL 智能体，但它们简化了 Minecraft 动作空间的部分内容，并且仍然需要手工设计的奖励。 Dreamer V4（Hafner 等，2025b）同样使用奖励，并且还需要专家动作来训练视频世界模型。 Pan-4B（Pantograph，2026）在 50 万小时的互联网视频上训练目标条件 RL 策略，但仍在 2000 小时的专家动作标注上进行后训练。 为了让长程任务更易于处理，许多工作借助语言模型来改进 Minecraft 策略。 MineDojo（Fan 等，2022）在整形奖励和学到的视频-语言评论家上训练 PPO 智能体，而 STEVE-1（Lifshitz 等，2023）、DEPS（Wang 等，2023）和 JARVIS-1（Wang 等，2024）则使用基于语言的规划。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, every plan is conditioned on the frames the agent actually observed, never on its previous plans. The VP therefore always plans from wherever the agent ended up, so deviations from earlier plans can be corrected. For the same reason, errors do not compound over time, which removes the need for anti-drift techniques against exposure bias in autoregressive video generation ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，每个计划都以智能体实际观测到的帧为条件，而从不以其先前的计划为条件。 因此，VP 总是从智能体实际所处的位置开始规划，从而可以纠正与早期计划的偏差。 出于同样的原因，误差不会随时间累积，这就免除了在自回归视频生成中对抗曝光偏差的防漂移技术的需要（Chen et al., 2024; Huang et al., 2025; Zhu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: This factorization differs from the world-model (WM) and policy decomposition used by VLAs and world-model agents ( Hafner et al., 2025b ) , although both model the same joint distribution:
paragraphs.zh: 这种因式分解不同于 VLA 和世界模型智能体（world-model agents）所使用的世界模型（WM）与策略分解方式（Hafner et al., 2025b），尽管二者建模的是同一个联合分布：

paragraphs.en: The two decompositions differ in where the difficult reasoning is learned. Long-horizon tasks require both procedural knowledge of what to do and physical knowledge of how the world responds. In the WM + policy decomposition, the policy must acquire the procedural knowledge and the WM the action-conditioned physical knowledge, both from scarce, embodiment-specific action data. In the VP + V2A decomposition, the VP learns both from abundant action-free video, which enables web-scale pretraining. This leaves the V2A model a much easier problem: a task-agnostic mapping from observed transitions to actions. It therefore needs far less embodiment-specific data, such as action labels. The VP + V2A decomposition is thus considerably more scalable, as our experiments (Section 4.1.2 ) and recent results in robot control ( Li et al., 2026 ) show.
paragraphs.zh: 两种分解方式的区别在于困难推理在何处被学习。 长时程任务既需要关于做什么的程序性知识，也需要关于世界如何响应的物理知识。 在世界模型+策略的分解中，策略必须获取程序性知识，世界模型必须获取动作条件下的物理知识，而两者都要从稀缺的、特定于具身形态的动作数据中学习。 在视频预测+视频到动作的分解中，视频预测模型可以从大量无动作视频中学习，这使得网络规模的预训练成为可能。 这给视频到动作模型留下了一个容易得多的问题：一个从观测到的状态转移映射到动作的、与任务无关的映射。 因此它所需的特定于具身形态的数据（例如动作标签）要少得多。 因此，视频预测+视频到动作的分解具有更强的可扩展性，正如我们的实验（第 4.1.2 节）以及机器人控制领域的近期成果（Li et al., 2026）所展示的那样。

sents.en: The two decompositions differ in where the difficult reasoning is learned.
sents.zh: 两种分解方式的区别在于困难推理在何处被学习。

sents.zh: 长时程任务既需要关于做什么的程序性知识，也需要关于世界如何响应的物理知识。

sents.en: In the WM + policy decomposition, the policy must acquire the procedural knowledge and the WM the action-conditioned physical knowledge, both from scarce, embodiment-specific action data.
sents.zh: 在世界模型+策略的分解中，策略必须获取程序性知识，世界模型必须获取动作条件下的物理知识，而两者都要从稀缺的、特定于具身形态的动作数据中学习。

sents.en: In the VP + V2A decomposition, the VP learns both from abundant action-free video, which enables web-scale pretraining.
sents.zh: 在视频预测+视频到动作的分解中，视频预测模型可以从大量无动作视频中学习，这使得网络规模的预训练成为可能。

sents.en: This leaves the V2A model a much easier problem: a task-agnostic mapping from observed transitions to actions.
sents.zh: 这给视频到动作模型留下了一个容易得多的问题：一个从观测到的状态转移映射到动作的、与任务无关的映射。

sents.en: It therefore needs far less embodiment-specific data, such as action labels.
sents.zh: 因此它所需的特定于具身形态的数据（例如动作标签）要少得多。

sents.en: The VP + V2A decomposition is thus considerably more scalable, as our experiments (Section 4.1.2 ) and recent results in robot control ( Li et al., 2026 ) show.
sents.zh: 因此，视频预测+视频到动作的分解具有更强的可扩展性，正如我们的实验（第 4.1.2 节）以及机器人控制领域的近期成果（Li et al., 2026）所展示的那样。

paragraphs.en: Our method, Mirror , reveals a far more striking consequence of this decomposition: given a capable VP and the ability to interact with the environment, the V2A model needs no action labels at all. Because it is task-agnostic, it can learn from any transition the agent itself produces, while the VP steers the agent toward the transitions the task requires. Section 3.1 shows how the V2A model can be trained from scratch on the data the agent collects while following these plans, and Section 3.2 describes how we make a generative video model VP practical for an online agent.

paragraphs.en: Exploration via stochastic V2A. Figure 1 illustrates how this process guides exploration. Early in training, the V2A model often fails to follow the plan, so the realized next observation o t + 1 o_{t+1} may differ substantially from the video plan o ^ t + 1 \hat{o}_{t+1} . However, even these failed attempts provide useful training examples: the V2A model still learns to predict the action that produced the observed transition. As the model improves, the agent can follow the planner more closely and reach later stages of the task. In turn, these rollouts provide data to improve the V2A model at the newly reached stages. Repeating this cycle allows the agent to progress ever further through the task. In contrast, purely random exploration often struggles to reach these stages because they require long sequences of consistently coordinated actions.
paragraphs.zh: 通过随机化的 V2A 进行探索。 图 1 展示了这一过程如何引导探索。 在训练早期，V2A 模型常常无法按照计划执行，因此实际得到的下一观测 o t + 1 o_{t+1} 可能与视频计划 o ^ t + 1 \hat{o}_{t+1} 有很大差异。 然而，即使是这些失败的尝试也能提供有用的训练样本：V2A 模型仍然学习预测产生所观测到的转移的动作。 随着模型不断改进，智能体能够更紧密地跟随规划器，到达任务的更后阶段。 反过来，这些 rollout 为改进 V2A 模型在新到达阶段的表现提供了数据。 重复这一循环使智能体能够在任务中不断取得更大进展。 相比之下，纯随机探索往往难以到达这些阶段，因为它们需要长序列持续协调一致的动作。

paragraphs.en: If the V2A model were trained only on data from its own rollouts, it would collapse to predicting the same action regardless of the observations. We hence make the V2A model stochastic during data collection by adding noise to its predictions. Stochasticity also plays a second, central role: carrying the agent past the stages it cannot yet execute (Figure 2 ). Where the V2A model is already competent, action noise is harmless: while the agent may drift off the currently active video plan, the video planner re-plans from the state actually reached, preventing error accumulation and allowing the agent to progress. At a milestone the V2A model has not yet learned, such as the first time a block has to be mined, the V2A model predicts the wrong action, and the agent thus fails to produce the planned transition. The planner, however, continues re-planning, repeatedly proposing the same transition. A deterministic agent would then be blocked at this milestone, as it would have never seen the action that would lead to this correct transition. The stochastic V2A model is what overcomes the roadblock: eventually, the correct random action is sampled, and the resulting transition enters the replay buffer (where it is then learned by the V2A model), enabling the agent to complete the milestone in future episodes. Random exploration, in contrast, would first have to stumble upon the entire action sequence leading to the milestone before it could even attempt the critical action, see Fig. 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 如果V2A模型仅在其自身的 rollout 数据上训练，它将退化为无论观测如何都预测相同的动作。 因此，我们在数据收集过程中通过向其预测添加噪声，使V2A模型具有随机性。 随机性还发挥着第二个核心作用：帮助智能体跨越它尚无法执行的阶段（图 2）。 在V2A模型已经胜任的地方，动作噪声是无害的：即使智能体可能偏离当前活跃的视频计划，视频规划器会从实际到达的状态重新规划，从而防止误差累积并让智能体继续前进。 在V2A模型尚未学会的里程碑处，例如首次需要挖掘方块时，V2A模型会预测错误的动作，因此智能体无法产生计划中的状态转移。 然而，规划器会继续重新规划，反复提出同一个状态转移。 一个确定性的智能体将会被卡在这个里程碑处，因为它永远不会见到能导致这一正确状态转移的动作。 正是随机性的V2A模型克服了这一障碍：最终，正确的随机动作被采样到，由此产生的状态转移进入回放缓冲区（随后由V2A模型从中学习），使智能体能够在未来的回合中完成该里程碑。 相比之下，随机探索则必须先偶然发现通向该里程碑的整个动作序列，才能尝试关键动作，见图 1。

paragraphs.en: Following plans in closed-loop places three demands on the VP. First, it must re-plan often and cheaply. Second, it must run over long episodes, often well over a minute in our Minecraft benchmarks. Third, it must stay on task even when the agent’s failures push it off the distribution of expert videos. To avoid re-encoding the history at every re-plan, we use a block-causal architecture: each observed frame is encoded once to cache its keys and values while the plan is denoised bidirectionally against this cache. Sliding-window attention over a fixed-size cache keeps the cost per plan constant, so a planner trained on 32 s clips can run on over 5 minutes of context without degradation. Finally, we propose task-aware guidance, which leverages diffusion guidance ( Ho & Salimans, 2022 ; Karras et al., 2024 ) to guide the task-conditional video planner with a task-unconditional one, significantly improving the planner’s task adherence. Figure 3 and Appendix A detail the architecture, training, and inference.
paragraphs.zh: 在闭环中执行计划对 VP 提出了三项要求。 首先，它必须频繁且低成本地重新规划。 其次，它必须在长回合中运行，在我们的 Minecraft 基准测试中通常远超一分钟。 第三，即使智能体的失败使其偏离专家视频的分布，它也必须始终专注于任务。 为了避免在每次重新规划时重新编码历史，我们采用块因果架构：每个观察到的帧只编码一次以缓存其键和值，同时计划针对该缓存进行双向去噪。 在固定大小缓存上的滑窗注意力使每次规划的成本保持恒定，因此在 32 秒片段上训练的规划器可以在超过 5 分钟的上下文上运行而不发生性能退化。 最后，我们提出任务感知引导，它利用扩散引导（Ho & Salimans, 2022；Karras et al., 2024）用一个无条件任务的模型来引导条件于任务的视频规划器，显著提升了规划器的任务遵循能力。 图 3 和附录 A 详细介绍了架构、训练和推理过程。

paragraphs.en: Mirror solves long-horizon challenges in Minecraft without reward supervision or expert actions. On Minecraft, we pre-train a video planner on 2,946 hours of videos from the VPT dataset ( Baker et al., 2022 ) , equipping our video planner with general physical and procedural knowledge of Minecraft. The VP is finetuned further for BASALT and Minecraft survival mode. With this VP, we are able to train our self-improving V2A model from scratch with self-play. Our agent operates in the MineRL 1.0 ( Guss et al., 2019 ) action space: at every step (20 Hz), it chooses among over 4,000 distinct combinations of 20 keyboard buttons while moving the mouse continuously in two dimensions. We do not simplify the action space or game mechanics.

paragraphs.en: Even without expert actions, Mirror outperforms all baselines that do not rely on hand-crafted heuristics. Only 5 hours of self-play were required to achieve the highest success rate on FindCave and MakeWaterfall tasks. To the best of our knowledge, Mirror is the first method to achieve non-zero success on MakeWaterfall from learned behavior alone (i.e., without classifiers or hard-coded actions). The baselines fail in different ways (Figure 18 ): the action-supervised methods (KAIROS, BC and UniTeam) drift out of distribution on multi-step tasks such as MakeWaterfall, the VLA models struggle to follow the task descriptions, and GoUp’s hard-coded scripts are brittle, placing, for instance, the water bucket but freezing once underwater, whereas Mirror escapes the water using knowledge learned from human gameplay. CreateAnimalPen and BuildVillageHouse remain unsolved by all learning-based methods. Lastly, while Mirror does not require action labels, it can still leverage them for a further small performance gain.
paragraphs.zh: 即使没有专家动作，Mirror 的表现也优于所有不依赖手工设计启发式规则的基线方法。 在 FindCave 和 MakeWaterfall 任务上达到最高成功率仅需 5 小时的自我博弈。 据我们所知，Mirror 是首个仅凭学习到的行为（即不使用分类器或硬编码动作）就在 MakeWaterfall 任务上取得非零成功率的方法。 各基线方法以不同方式失败（图 18）：动作监督方法（KAIROS、BC 和 UniTeam）在 MakeWaterfall 等多步任务上偏离分布，VLA 模型难以遵循任务描述，而 GoUp 的硬编码脚本十分脆弱，例如会放置水桶但一到水下就卡住不动，而 Mirror 则利用从人类游戏中学到的知识逃离水下。 CreateAnimalPen 和 BuildVillageHouse 仍然是所有基于学习的方法都未能解决的任务。 最后，虽然 Mirror 不需要动作标签，但它仍然可以利用这些标签获得进一步的少量性能提升。

paragraphs.en: We next evaluate Mirror on the Minecraft Diamond Challenge ( Guss et al., 2019 ) , in which the agent must obtain a diamond in survival mode, starting from a new world and an empty inventory. In the online setting, Mirror is the first method to acquire an iron pickaxe through self-improvement alone, without reward supervision or expert action labels. In the offline setting, where expert action labels are available but environment interaction is not, Mirror obtains diamonds at nearly eight times the success rate of Dreamer V4 ( Hafner et al., 2025b ) , the state-of-the-art world-model agent on Minecraft (Figure 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 接下来我们在 Minecraft 钻石挑战赛（Guss et al., 2019）上评估 Mirror，在该挑战中，智能体必须从一个全新的世界和空空如也的物品栏出发，在生存模式中获得一颗钻石。 在在线设置下，Mirror 是首个仅通过自我改进、无需奖励监督或专家动作标签就能获得铁镐的方法。 在离线设置下，即可以获得专家动作标签但无法与环境交互时，Mirror 获得钻石的成功率接近 Dreamer V4（Hafner et al., 2025b）——Minecraft 上最先进的世界模型智能体——的八倍（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: Unlike the BASALT tasks, the Diamond Challenge has an unambiguous and easily verifiable objective, but reaching it requires an extremely long horizon of up to an hour of gameplay. The agent must complete a long chain of prerequisite subgoals, from chopping trees and crafting tools to smelting iron and mining deep underground. While our video planner alone can solve the 3–5-minute BASALT tasks without any task decomposition (Sec. 4.1.1 ), an hour-long horizon remains beyond it. Such a horizon is hard even for humans: players given 20 minutes to obtain a diamond pickaxe collect diamonds in only 15% of episodes ( Baker et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 与 BASALT 任务不同，钻石挑战有一个明确且易于验证的目标，但达成它需要极长的时间跨度，最长可达一小时的游戏时间。 智能体必须完成一长串前置子目标，从砍树和制作工具，到冶炼铁和深入地下采矿。 虽然我们的视频规划器单独就能在不做任何任务分解的情况下解决 3–5 分钟的 BASALT 任务（见第 4.1.1 节），但一小时的时间跨度仍然超出了它的能力范围。 即使对人类来说，这样的时间跨度也很难：给定 20 分钟获取钻石镐的玩家，只在 15% 的回合中成功采集到钻石（Baker 等，2022）。

paragraphs.en: To solve such an extremely long-horizon task, we follow Dreamer V4 and condition the agent on its current subgoal. Whereas Dreamer V4 conditions its policy on one-hot task embeddings, we instead condition only the video planner: we finetune it on subgoal intervals of VPT human gameplay with text prompts that describe the subgoal. During rollouts, a heuristic subgoal task planner chooses the prompt from the player’s own state, namely the inventory, the health, and whether a GUI screen is open. The V2A model therefore never observes the subgoal. Since Dreamer V4 publishes neither how it extracts subgoal intervals from the VPT recordings nor how it decides when to advance to the next subgoal during evaluation, we implement our own data curation (Appendix B.1.4 ) and heuristic subgoal task planner (Appendix B.1.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这种极长时间跨度的任务，我们遵循 Dreamer V4 的做法，以当前的子目标作为智能体的条件。 Dreamer V4 使用独热任务嵌入作为策略的条件，而我们仅对视频规划器施加条件：我们在 VPT 人类游玩录像的子目标区间上，使用描述该子目标的文本提示对视频规划器进行微调。 在 rollout 过程中，一个启发式子目标任务规划器根据玩家自身的状态（即物品栏、生命值，以及是否打开了 GUI 界面）来选择提示。 因此，V2A 模型从不观察子目标。 由于 Dreamer V4 既没有公布它如何从 VPT 录像中提取子目标区间，也没有公布它在评估时如何决定何时推进到下一个子目标，因此我们实现了自己的数据整理方法（附录 B.1.4）和启发式子目标任务规划器（附录 B.1.5）。

paragraphs.en: To study the video planner independently of the self-improvement algorithm, we first evaluate it with a V2A model pretrained on 3k hours of paired human action-demonstration data from the VPT dataset ( Baker et al., 2022 ) . In this offline setting, our agent sets a new state of the art, obtaining a diamond in 5.5% of episodes, compared with 0.7% for Dreamer 4 ( Hafner et al., 2025b ) , the best world-model agent. This supports the VP + V2A decomposition in equation 1 over WM + policy decompositions such as Dreamer 4’s. A WM + policy agent must learn procedural and physical knowledge from action-labeled data, whereas the VP learns both from internet-scale video. Vision-language pretraining does not supply this knowledge either: the Gemma 3-based VLA ( Team, 2025 ) evaluated by Hafner et al. (2025b) never obtains a diamond.

paragraphs.en: Without action labels or rewards, our self-improving V2A model matches its supervised counterpart on early-game items and remains competitive with offline methods trained on 2.5k hours of action-labeled demonstrations. We begin self-improvement with a V2A model trained from scratch and a goal to acquire wood. While the V2A model may output random actions early in training, re-planning allows the agent to recover from its mistakes so it remains in distribution. Once the agent succeeds at a goal, the text prompt is updated with the next goal. The agent thus collects progressively more challenging items through online interaction. Appendix B.1.6 details the exploration strategy and the training protocol. After 140 hours of online interaction (about 10M environment steps), our agent crafts a stone pickaxe in 72.7% of episodes and an iron pickaxe in 15.6%. At the same budget, Dreamer V3 ( Hafner et al., 2025a ) crafts an iron pickaxe in only 1.7% of episodes, despite using task rewards, simplified crafting, and accelerated mining (Figure 5 ). Mirror retains a large margin even when matching Dreamer V3’s evaluation protocol (Appendix C.1.3 ), in which episodes last 30 minutes and end at the first death, rather than the 60-minute episodes with respawning used by VPT ( Baker et al., 2022 ) and Dreamer V4 ( Hafner et al., 2025b ) .

paragraphs.en: Generative video planners are already capable, and we expect them to keep improving. To examine how Mirror scales with better planners, we decouple self-improvement from the generative VP using an oracle video planner (oracle VP), which we construct from an expert policy and a copy of the environment. At each planning step, we synchronize a separate instance of the game to the agent’s current state and let the expert policy, conditioned on the agent’s past observations o ≤ t o_{\leq t} , play forward in it. The frames rendered by this copy serve as the plan o ^ t + 1 \hat{o}_{t+1} , so the oracle has the same input-output behavior as a video planner, p 𝚅𝙿 ​ ( o ^ t + 1 ∣ o ≤ t ) p_{\tt{VP}}(\hat{o}_{t+1}\mid o_{\leq t}) , while the expert’s actions are never shown to the V2A model.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式视频规划器已经具备较强的能力，我们预计它们会持续改进。 为了研究 Mirror 如何随更强的规划器而扩展，我们使用一个先知视频规划器（先知 VP）将自我提升与生成式 VP 解耦，该先知规划器由专家策略和一份环境副本构成。 在每个规划步骤中，我们将游戏的另一个实例同步到智能体的当前状态，并让以智能体的过去观测 o ≤ t o_{\leq t} 为条件的专家策略在其中向前推演。 该副本渲染出的帧作为规划 o ^ t + 1 \hat{o}_{t+1}，因此先知具有与视频规划器相同的输入输出行为 p 𝚅𝙿 ​ ( o ^ t + 1 ∣ o ≤ t ) p_{\tt{VP}}(\hat{o}_{t+1}\mid o_{\leq t})，同时专家的动作从不展示给 V2A 模型。

paragraphs.en: Using VPT’s early-game RL policy ( Baker et al., 2022 ) as the oracle, we train a V2A model from scratch with self-play. After only about 80 hours of online interaction, the agent acquires diamonds for the first time (Figure 5 ), an order of magnitude fewer environment interactions than Dreamer V3 ( Hafner et al., 2025a ) requires, despite Dreamer V3’s use of simplified crafting and accelerated mining. RL agents take far longer because they must explore the full action space on their own. This experiment suggests that the remaining bottleneck is not Mirror ’s ability to learn from interaction, but the capability of the video planner itself.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以 VPT 的早期游戏强化学习策略（Baker et al., 2022）作为 oracle，通过自我博弈从头训练了一个 V2A 模型。 仅经过约 80 小时的在线交互，智能体就首次获得了钻石（图 5），其环境交互次数比 Dreamer V3（Hafner et al., 2025a）所需的少了整整一个数量级，而 Dreamer V3 还使用了简化合成与加速挖掘。 强化学习智能体所需的时间要长得多，因为它们必须自行探索完整动作空间。 该实验表明，剩余的瓶颈不在 Mirror 从交互中学习的能力，而在于视频规划器自身的能力。

paragraphs.en: Training the video planner on internet-scale video data unlocks novel capabilities without requiring additional fine-tuning for each task. We explore such emergent behaviors in two settings.
paragraphs.zh: 在互联网规模的视频数据上训练视频规划器，能够解锁新的能力，而无需针对每个任务进行额外的微调。 我们在两种设置中探索了这类涌现行为。

paragraphs.en: We examine if Mirror can utilize its history, o ≤ t o_{\leq t} , for in-context learning. In Figure 6 , we challenge our agent to escape a lava lake. If the agent falls in the lava, it respawns at the origin. We compare a case where the agent’s history is preserved between deaths, and a case when the history is reset after every death. The task is difficult: with fresh histories every life, the escape rate is only 3%. When video context is retained between lives, however, the agent leverages its past failures to improve its escape rate. Figure 6 (b) shows the resulting agent’s trajectories. With shared history, the agent exhibits a clear directional bias, demonstrating that prior attempts influence the agent’s behavior. With independent history, the agent moves in relatively uniform directions around the starting point. Retaining history does not provide a comparable benefit to the VPT BC policy, perhaps even hindering performance. This experiment shows that our video planning agent exhibits some emergent in-context adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检验 Mirror 能否利用其历史 o ≤ t o_{\leq t} 进行上下文学习。 在图 6 中，我们挑战我们的智能体逃离一片熔岩湖。 如果智能体掉入熔岩，它会在原点重生。 我们比较了两种情况：一种是在死亡之间保留智能体的历史，另一种是在每次死亡后重置历史。 该任务很困难：如果每次生命都使用全新的历史，逃脱率仅为 3%。 然而，当视频上下文在生命之间被保留时，智能体能够利用其过去的失败来提高逃脱率。 图 6 (b) 展示了所产生的智能体的轨迹。 在共享历史的情况下，智能体表现出明显的方向性偏好，这表明先前的尝试会影响智能体的行为。 在独立历史的情况下，智能体在起点周围以相对均匀的方向移动。 保留历史并未给 VPT BC 策略带来可比的收益，甚至可能损害其性能。 该实验表明，我们的视频规划智能体表现出一定的涌现式上下文适应能力。

paragraphs.en: As a proof of concept, we test whether our pretrained video planner can be steered by text zero-shot. Since our planner was trained only on captions generated automatically by a small VLM (Appendix A.4 ), we evaluate simple goals such as “chop down the tree” or “dig into the ground,” rather than complex instructions. Accordingly, we do not aim to compete in language understanding with Minecraft-specialized vision-language-action models such as JARVIS-VLA ( Li et al., 2025 ) and OpenHA ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Each task nevertheless lasts about 30 seconds and requires consistent, prolonged behavior. We pair the text-conditioned video planner with a V2A model pre-trained on random walks, a V2A model pre-trained on the VPT expert actions, and our self-improving V2A model. We also compare against VIPER ( Escontrela et al., 2023 ) , which similarly does not use action labels, and a text-conditioned BC policy (Appendix C.1.4 ). As shown in Figure 7 , Mirror reliably harvests trees, climbs hills, and digs underground, although some tasks remain difficult across all V2A variants. The self-improving V2A model generally outperforms the one trained on random walks and remains competitive with the one supervised on human actions. These results show that the V2A model can execute plans without ever knowing the task. Since the V2A model is task-agnostic, a sufficiently capable video planner would let the agent solve new tasks from a text prompt alone, without task-specific action data or retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 作为概念验证，我们测试了预训练的视频规划器能否在零样本情况下被文本引导。 由于我们的规划器仅在由小型视觉语言模型（VLM）自动生成的字幕上训练（附录 A.4），我们评估的是诸如“砍倒树”或“挖进地面”等简单目标，而非复杂指令。 因此，我们并不打算在语言理解方面与 Minecraft 专用的视觉-语言-动作模型（如 JARVIS-VLA（Li et al., 2025）和 OpenHA（Wang et al., 2025））竞争。 尽管如此，每个任务大约持续 30 秒，并需要持续、长时间的行为。 我们将文本条件化的视频规划器与在随机游走上预训练的 V2A 模型、在 VPT 专家动作上预训练的 V2A 模型，以及我们的自我改进 V2A 模型进行配对。 我们还与 VIPER（Escontrela et al., 2023）（同样不使用动作标签）以及文本条件化的 BC 策略（附录 C.1.4）进行比较。 如图 7 所示，Mirror 能够可靠地砍伐树木、攀爬丘陵和挖掘地下，尽管某些任务在所有 V2A 变体中仍然困难。 自我改进的 V2A 模型总体上优于在随机游走上训练的模型，并与在人类动作上监督训练的模型保持竞争力。 这些结果表明，V2A 模型可以在完全不知道任务的情况下执行计划。 由于 V2A 模型是与任务无关的，一个足够强大的视频规划器可以让智能体仅凭文本提示解决新任务，而无需任务特定的动作数据或重新训练。

sents.en: As a proof of concept, we test whether our pretrained video planner can be steered by text zero-shot.
sents.zh: 作为概念验证，我们测试了预训练的视频规划器能否在零样本情况下被文本引导。

sents.en: Since our planner was trained only on captions generated automatically by a small VLM (Appendix A.4 ), we evaluate simple goals such as “chop down the tree” or “dig into the ground,” rather than complex instructions.
sents.zh: 由于我们的规划器仅在由小型视觉语言模型（VLM）自动生成的字幕上训练（附录 A.4），我们评估的是诸如“砍倒树”或“挖进地面”等简单目标，而非复杂指令。

sents.en: Accordingly, we do not aim to compete in language understanding with Minecraft-specialized vision-language-action models such as JARVIS-VLA ( Li et al., 2025 ) and OpenHA ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 因此，我们并不打算在语言理解方面与 Minecraft 专用的视觉-语言-动作模型（如 JARVIS-VLA（Li et al., 2025）和 OpenHA（Wang et al., 2025））竞争。

sents.en: Each task nevertheless lasts about 30 seconds and requires consistent, prolonged behavior.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，每个任务大约持续 30 秒，并需要持续、长时间的行为。

sents.en: We pair the text-conditioned video planner with a V2A model pre-trained on random walks, a V2A model pre-trained on the VPT expert actions, and our self-improving V2A model.
sents.zh: 我们将文本条件化的视频规划器与在随机游走上预训练的 V2A 模型、在 VPT 专家动作上预训练的 V2A 模型，以及我们的自我改进 V2A 模型进行配对。

sents.en: We also compare against VIPER ( Escontrela et al., 2023 ) , which similarly does not use action labels, and a text-conditioned BC policy (Appendix C.1.4 ).
sents.zh: 我们还与 VIPER（Escontrela et al., 2023）（同样不使用动作标签）以及文本条件化的 BC 策略（附录 C.1.4）进行比较。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 7 , Mirror reliably harvests trees, climbs hills, and digs underground, although some tasks remain difficult across all V2A variants.
sents.zh: 如图 7 所示，Mirror 能够可靠地砍伐树木、攀爬丘陵和挖掘地下，尽管某些任务在所有 V2A 变体中仍然困难。

sents.en: The self-improving V2A model generally outperforms the one trained on random walks and remains competitive with the one supervised on human actions.
sents.zh: 自我改进的 V2A 模型总体上优于在随机游走上训练的模型，并与在人类动作上监督训练的模型保持竞争力。

sents.en: These results show that the V2A model can execute plans without ever knowing the task.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，V2A 模型可以在完全不知道任务的情况下执行计划。

sents.en: Since the V2A model is task-agnostic, a sufficiently capable video planner would let the agent solve new tasks from a text prompt alone, without task-specific action data or retraining.
sents.zh: 由于 V2A 模型是与任务无关的，一个足够强大的视频规划器可以让智能体仅凭文本提示解决新任务，而无需任务特定的动作数据或重新训练。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We evaluate Mirror on standard subsets of key synthetic decision-making benchmarks: OGBench ( Park et al., 2025a ) , DeepMindControl ( Tassa et al., 2018 ) , and Atari ( Bellemare et al., 2013 ; Escontrela et al., 2023 ) . We benchmark with BCO ( Torabi et al., 2018 ) , which alternates between learning a V2A on policy rollouts and cloning its inferred actions on expert demonstrations, VIPER ( Escontrela et al., 2023 ) , which uses video prediction likelihoods as rewards, LAIfO ( Giammarino et al., 2024 ) , which learns a policy by adversarially matching expert and agent transitions, and the method proposed by Luo & Du (2024) (which we abbreviate as “Grounding”) which learns a goal-conditioned policy to reach video-predicted subgoals. We evaluate Mirror with both a learned video planner and an oracle planner that supplies future frames from an RL expert. Unlike in our Minecraft setting, large-scale human play datasets are not available, and we thus found it essential to augment the generative planner’s training data with recovery examples collected using DAgger ( Ross et al., 2011 ) . Please find an in-depth discussion of dataset construction, evaluated tasks, planner training, and baseline implementations in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 我们在关键合成决策基准测试的标准子集上评估 Mirror：OGBench（Park 等，2025a）、DeepMindControl（Tassa 等，2018）和 Atari（Bellemare 等，2013；Escontrela 等，2023）。 我们与以下方法进行对比：BCO（Torabi 等，2018），它在策略回放上学习 V2A 并在专家演示上克隆其推断的动作；VIPER（Escontrela 等，2023），它使用视频预测似然作为奖励；LAIfO（Giammarino 等，2024），它通过对抗性地匹配专家与智能体的转移来学习策略；以及 Luo & Du（2024）提出的方法（我们简称为「Grounding」），它学习一个目标条件策略以到达视频预测的子目标。 我们使用学习到的视频规划器以及提供来自 RL 专家的未来帧的先知规划器来评估 Mirror。 与我们的 Minecraft 设定不同，这里没有大规模的人类游戏数据集可用，因此我们发现必须使用通过 DAgger（Ross 等，2011）收集的恢复样本来增广生成式规划器的训练数据。 关于数据集构建、评估任务、规划器训练和基线实现的深入讨论请参见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: Generative VP results. As shown in Figure 8 , among methods evaluated without oracle planners, Mirror surpasses all baselines on Atari and OGBench, and learns faster than LAIfO on DMC. LAIfO performs less consistently across domains, learning less efficiently on OGBench and achieving limited returns on Atari. VIPER also achieves low returns on Atari, suggesting that using video model predictions directly provides better supervision than likelihood-based rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式 VP 的结果。 如图 8 所示，在不使用先知规划器进行评估的方法中，Mirror 在 Atari 和 OGBench 上超越了所有基线，并且在 DMC 上比 LAIfO 学习得更快。 LAIfO 在不同领域上的表现不够稳定，在 OGBench 上学习效率较低，在 Atari 上取得的回报也很有限。 VIPER 在 Atari 上同样获得了较低的回报，这表明直接使用视频模型的预测比基于似然的奖励能提供更好的监督信号。

sents.en: Generative VP results.
sents.zh: 生成式 VP 的结果。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 8 , among methods evaluated without oracle planners, Mirror surpasses all baselines on Atari and OGBench, and learns faster than LAIfO on DMC.
sents.zh: 如图 8 所示，在不使用先知规划器进行评估的方法中，Mirror 在 Atari 和 OGBench 上超越了所有基线，并且在 DMC 上比 LAIfO 学习得更快。

sents.zh: LAIfO 在不同领域上的表现不够稳定，在 OGBench 上学习效率较低，在 Atari 上取得的回报也很有限。

sents.zh: VIPER 在 Atari 上同样获得了较低的回报，这表明直接使用视频模型的预测比基于似然的奖励能提供更好的监督信号。

paragraphs.en: The comparisons with BCO and Grounding help explain these gains. Although BCO also learns a V2A model from self-collected experience, it performs substantially worse, indicating the importance of using the video planner to guide data collection. Grounding improves on BCO, consistent with the benefit of video-guided exploration, but still remains substantially below Mirror . The remaining gap suggests an advantage to learning a V2A model that translates frame-to-frame transitions into actions over learning a goal-conditioned policy to reach predicted subgoals.
paragraphs.zh: 与 BCO 和 Grounding 的对比有助于解释这些性能提升。 尽管 BCO 同样从自采集经验中学习 V2A 模型，但其表现明显更差，这表明使用视频规划器来引导数据采集的重要性。 Grounding 相比 BCO 有所提升，这与视频引导探索的收益相一致，但仍明显低于 Mirror。 剩余的差距表明，学习一个将逐帧转换映射为动作的 V2A 模型，相比学习一个用于到达预测子目标的目标条件策略，具有优势。

sents.zh: 与 BCO 和 Grounding 的对比有助于解释这些性能提升。

paragraphs.en: Oracle VP results. To evaluate our self-improvement algorithm independently of video-planner quality, we also use an Oracle VP that supplies frames from an RL expert. In this setting, our method matches the expert on Atari, suggesting that our Atari performance is limited by the video planner, most likely by the compute needed to train a model that accurately predicts fine details such as the motion of small projectiles. This result demonstrates that as video models continue to scale and improve, our method provides a simple framework that is able to solve a wide variety of tasks. In Appendix C.2 , we also demonstrate that Mirror learns a V2A model that generalizes better to unseen goals.
paragraphs.zh: Oracle VP 结果。 为了独立于视频规划器质量来评估我们的自我改进算法，我们还使用了一个 Oracle VP（智能体），它提供来自 RL 专家的帧。 在此设置下，我们的方法在 Atari 上达到了专家水平，这表明我们的 Atari 性能受限于视频规划器，最可能是受限于训练一个能准确预测细微细节（如小型抛射物的运动）的模型所需的计算量。 这一结果表明，随着视频模型不断扩展和改进，我们的方法提供了一个简单的框架，能够解决各种各样的任务。 在附录 C.2 中，我们还证明了 Mirror 学习到的 V2A 模型对未见目标具有更好的泛化能力。

sents.en: Oracle VP results.
sents.zh: Oracle VP 结果。

sents.en: In Appendix C.2 , we also demonstrate that Mirror learns a V2A model that generalizes better to unseen goals.
sents.zh: 在附录 C.2 中，我们还证明了 Mirror 学习到的 V2A 模型对未见目标具有更好的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Mirror also exceeds the expert’s return in Assault and Zaxxon by 10% and 25%, respectively. We observe that the expert issues redundant fire commands that do not produce additional shots. The V2A model can thus follow the plan without copying them. As a result, Mirror makes fewer ineffective firing attempts in Assault, reducing overheating, and releases FIRE more frequently in Zaxxon, enabling subsequent presses to trigger new shots.
paragraphs.zh: Mirror 在 Assault 和 Zaxxon 中也分别以 10% 和 25% 的幅度超过专家的回报。 我们观察到专家会发出冗余的开火指令，这些指令并不会产生额外的射击。 因此 V2A 模型可以在不复制这些指令的情况下遵循该计划。 结果，Mirror 在 Assault 中减少了无效的开火尝试，从而降低过热，并在 Zaxxon 中更频繁地释放 FIRE，使后续按键能够触发新的射击。

sents.zh: Mirror 在 Assault 和 Zaxxon 中也分别以 10% 和 25% 的幅度超过专家的回报。

sents.en: We observe that the expert issues redundant fire commands that do not produce additional shots.
sents.zh: 我们观察到专家会发出冗余的开火指令，这些指令并不会产生额外的射击。

sents.en: The V2A model can thus follow the plan without copying them.
sents.zh: 因此 V2A 模型可以在不复制这些指令的情况下遵循该计划。

paragraphs.en: We have introduced Mirror , a method that learns to translate behaviors encoded in large video planners to policies executable by an agent. Unlike prior work, our method assumes neither paired video-action data nor task-specific rewards, but instead learns to translate video into actions simply by self-play in an interactive environment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Mirror，这是一种学习方法，能够将大型视频规划器编码的行为转化为可由智能体执行的策略。 与以往的工作不同，我们的方法既不需要成对的“视频-动作”数据，也不需要任务特定的奖励，而是仅通过在交互环境中进行自我博弈来学习将视频转化为动作。

sents.en: We have introduced Mirror , a method that learns to translate behaviors encoded in large video planners to policies executable by an agent.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 Mirror，这是一种学习方法，能够将大型视频规划器编码的行为转化为可由智能体执行的策略。

sents.en: Unlike prior work, our method assumes neither paired video-action data nor task-specific rewards, but instead learns to translate video into actions simply by self-play in an interactive environment.
sents.zh: 与以往的工作不同，我们的方法既不需要成对的“视频-动作”数据，也不需要任务特定的奖励，而是仅通过在交互环境中进行自我博弈来学习将视频转化为动作。

paragraphs.en: Our approach has several limitations. First, without a separate high-level task planner that conditions the video planner on subgoals, our agent could not cover the hour-long horizon of the diamond task. We expect capable VLM-based task planners to fill this role in the future: VLMs excel at abstract, high-level task planning but struggle with dense, low-level control, whereas video planners show the opposite strengths, making the two naturally complementary. Second, with self-improvement alone, our agent reaches the iron pickaxe but does not yet mine diamonds. An imperfect V2A model often leads the agent into suboptimal states that human players rarely visit, and recovering from them demands very strong generalization from the video planner. Our video planner falls short of this at later milestones, each of which is covered by only a few hours of human gameplay in our training data. Third, some actions leave no visible trace, so inferring them from vision alone and from scratch is ill-posed; in practice, we expect a small amount of action data to resolve this. Lastly, training a capable generative video planner can be data-intensive. Unlike human gameplay, which naturally contains mistakes and recoveries, the data generated by expert policies in our robotics and control benchmarks (Section 4.2 ) lacked diversity, so we needed to augment it with recovery data collected via DAgger ( Ross et al., 2011 ) to train a sufficiently robust video planner.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法存在若干局限性。 首先，如果没有一个独立的高层任务规划器来让视频规划器以子目标为条件，我们的智能体就无法覆盖钻石任务长达一小时的时间跨度。 我们预计未来将有强大的基于 VLM 的任务规划器来承担这一角色：VLM 擅长抽象的高层任务规划，但难以进行密集的低层控制，而视频规划器则表现出相反的优势，二者天然互补。 其次，仅靠自我改进，我们的智能体能够到达铁镐阶段，但还无法挖掘钻石。 一个不完美的 V2A 模型常常会使智能体进入人类玩家很少造访的次优状态，而从这些状态中恢复需要对视频规划器有非常强的泛化能力。 我们的视频规划器在后期里程碑上未能达到这一要求，而这些里程碑在我们的训练数据中各自仅有几个小时的人类游戏过程覆盖。 第三，某些动作不会留下可见的痕迹，因此仅凭视觉从零开始推断这些动作是一个不适定问题；在实践中，我们预计少量动作数据即可解决这一问题。 最后，训练一个强大的生成式视频规划器可能需要大量数据。 与天然包含错误和恢复行为的人类游戏过程不同，我们的机器人与控制基准（第 4.2 节）中由专家策略生成的数据缺乏多样性，因此我们需要通过 DAgger（Ross et al., 2011）收集的恢复数据对其进行扩充，以训练出足够鲁棒的视频规划器。

sents.en: Our approach has several limitations.
sents.zh: 我们的方法存在若干局限性。

sents.en: First, without a separate high-level task planner that conditions the video planner on subgoals, our agent could not cover the hour-long horizon of the diamond task.
sents.zh: 首先，如果没有一个独立的高层任务规划器来让视频规划器以子目标为条件，我们的智能体就无法覆盖钻石任务长达一小时的时间跨度。

sents.zh: 其次，仅靠自我改进，我们的智能体能够到达铁镐阶段，但还无法挖掘钻石。

sents.zh: 一个不完美的 V2A 模型常常会使智能体进入人类玩家很少造访的次优状态，而从这些状态中恢复需要对视频规划器有非常强的泛化能力。

sents.zh: 我们的视频规划器在后期里程碑上未能达到这一要求，而这些里程碑在我们的训练数据中各自仅有几个小时的人类游戏过程覆盖。

sents.en: Third, some actions leave no visible trace, so inferring them from vision alone and from scratch is ill-posed; in practice, we expect a small amount of action data to resolve this.
sents.zh: 第三，某些动作不会留下可见的痕迹，因此仅凭视觉从零开始推断这些动作是一个不适定问题；在实践中，我们预计少量动作数据即可解决这一问题。

sents.en: Lastly, training a capable generative video planner can be data-intensive.
sents.zh: 最后，训练一个强大的生成式视频规划器可能需要大量数据。

sents.en: Unlike human gameplay, which naturally contains mistakes and recoveries, the data generated by expert policies in our robotics and control benchmarks (Section 4.2 ) lacked diversity, so we needed to augment it with recovery data collected via DAgger ( Ross et al., 2011 ) to train a sufficiently robust video planner.
sents.zh: 与天然包含错误和恢复行为的人类游戏过程不同，我们的机器人与控制基准（第 4.2 节）中由专家策略生成的数据缺乏多样性，因此我们需要通过 DAgger（Ross et al., 2011）收集的恢复数据对其进行扩充，以训练出足够鲁棒的视频规划器。

paragraphs.en: We believe Mirror offers a promising path toward general-purpose agents that acquire diverse behaviors from video pre-training and learn to self-improve their execution through interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们相信，Mirror 为通用智能体提供了一条有前景的路径：这类智能体通过视频预训练习得多样化行为，并通过交互学会自我改进其执行能力。

paragraphs.en: The central goal behind the design of our video planner is long context. Many of our tasks require memory over long horizons. Long context may also help error recovery in closed-loop planning. Early in training, the imperfect V2A model often deviates from expert behavior, forcing the planner to operate on trajectories outside its training distribution. With a short context, we often saw the planner repeat the same failed behavior. With long context, we instead observed emergent recovery behavior, as the planner can use its previous failures to change strategy (see Sec. 4.1.3 ) and replan. This section describes how we make such long context affordable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们视频规划器设计背后的核心目标是长上下文。 我们的许多任务需要在长时程上的记忆。 长上下文还有助于闭环规划中的错误恢复。 在训练早期，不完美的 V2A 模型常常偏离专家行为，迫使规划器在其训练分布之外的轨迹上运行。 在上下文较短时，我们经常看到规划器重复同样的失败行为。 在上下文较长时，我们反而观察到了涌现出的恢复行为，因为规划器可以利用其之前的失败来改变策略（见第 4.1.3 节）并重新规划。 本节描述我们如何让这样的长上下文变得可行。

paragraphs.en: Videos are encoded with the Wan2.2 VAE ( Wan Team, 2025 ) , which compresses 4 frames in time and 16 × 16 16\times 16 pixels in space into 48 latent channels. The zeroth pixel frame is encoded on its own rather than grouped with other frames, so L L latent frames correspond to 1 + 4 ​ ( L − 1 ) 1+4(L-1) pixel frames. The MineRL environment ( Baker et al., 2022 ) renders 640 × 360 640\times 360 frames at 20 fps. We resize each frame to 320 × 192 320\times 192 , so that every four-frame chunk (0.2 s) is encoded into a 12 × 20 × 48 12\times 20\times 48 latent array (height × \times width × \times channels). A 2 × 2 2\times 2 patchifier then turns each latent frame into 60 tokens of 192 dimensions, which form the input of the video planner.
paragraphs.zh: 视频使用 Wan2.2 VAE（Wan Team, 2025）进行编码，该编码器将时间上压缩 4 帧、空间上压缩 16 × 16 16\times 16 像素的视频编码为 48 个潜变量通道。 第零个像素帧单独编码，而不是与其他帧一起分组编码，因此 L L 个潜变量帧对应 1 + 4 ​ ( L − 1 ) 1+4(L-1) 个像素帧。 MineRL 环境（Baker et al., 2022）以 20 fps 渲染 640 × 360 640\times 360 的帧。 我们将每帧调整为 320 × 192 320\times 192 的尺寸，使每个四帧块（0.2 秒）被编码为一个 12 × 20 × 48 12\times 20\times 48 的潜变量数组（高 × \times 宽 × \times 通道）。 随后一个 2 × 2 2\times 2 的分块器将每个潜变量帧转换为 60 个 192 维的词元，这些词元构成视频规划器的输入。

paragraphs.en: The planner is initialized from Cosmos3-Nano ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , a mixture of transformers ( Liang et al., 2024b ) with a text tower and a video tower. The two towers share the same Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) block design but have separate weights. Each has 7B parameters, 36 layers of width 4096, 32q / 8kv GQA heads of dimension 128, SwiGLU MLPs of width 12,288. For positional embedding, 3D-MROPE ( Su et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA, 2026 ) is used in which the 128 128 -dim attention head is split into [ 48 , 24 , 24 ] [48,24,24] -dims, each encoding the time, height and width of the video. We freeze the text tower and finetune only the video tower. The video tower plays two roles: as a context encoder , it encodes the clean history of observed frames, and as a denoiser , it denoises the frames of the plan. We refer to the two roles separately for clarity, although they share the same architecture and weights.
paragraphs.zh: 规划器以 Cosmos3-Nano（NVIDIA，2026）初始化，它是一个混合变换器（Liang 等，2024b），包含一个文本塔和一个视频塔。 两个塔共享相同的 Qwen3-VL（Bai 等，2025）块设计，但权重各自独立。 每个塔有 7B 参数，36 层，宽度为 4096，32 个查询头 / 8 个键值头的 GQA，每维 128，MLP 采用宽度为 12,288 的 SwiGLU。 在位置嵌入方面，使用 3D-MROPE（Su 等，2024；Bai 等，2025；NVIDIA，2026），将 128 维注意力头拆分为 [48, 24, 24] 维，分别编码视频的时间、高度和宽度。 我们冻结文本塔，仅对视频塔进行微调。 视频塔承担两个角色：作为上下文编码器，它对已观测帧的干净历史进行编码；作为去噪器，它对计划中的帧进行去噪。 尽管两者共享相同的架构与权重，为了表述清晰，我们仍将这两个角色分开称呼。

paragraphs.en: The original Cosmos3 implementation uses NATTEN ( Hassani et al., 2023 ) , which cannot efficiently express our block-causal sliding-window attention pattern. We instead use FlexAttention ( Dong et al., 2024 ) , which supports efficient attention with arbitrary block-sparse masks. On NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, we use FlexAttention’s experimental FlashAttention-4 ( Zadouri et al., 2026 ) backend, which is 1.35–1.55 × \times faster than the default Triton ( Tillet et al., 2019 ) backend on our workload. On AMD GPUs, we use the Triton backend.
paragraphs.zh: 原始的 Cosmos3 实现使用 NATTEN（Hassani 等，2023），它无法高效地表达我们的块因果滑动窗口注意力模式。 我们改用 FlexAttention（Dong 等，2024），它支持带任意块稀疏掩码的高效注意力。 在 NVIDIA Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 上，我们使用 FlexAttention 的实验性 FlashAttention-4（Zadouri 等，2026）后端，在我们的工作负载上它比默认的 Triton（Tillet 等，2019）后端快 1.35–1.55 × \times 倍。 在 AMD GPU 上，我们使用 Triton 后端。

paragraphs.en: In the original Cosmos3, all video tokens attend to each other bidirectionally under a single mask. In our implementation, however, the video tower’s role is split into a context encoder and a denoiser, which require distinct attention patterns. The video history is block-causally encoded frame by frame, whereas the future plans are jointly denoised and thus require bidirectional attention. Together with the text, this yields three token streams. At every layer, each stream self-attends to its own tokens and cross-attends to the streams it is conditioned on:
paragraphs.zh: 在原版 Cosmos3 中，所有视频 token 在单一掩码下进行双向相互注意力计算。 然而在我们的实现中，视频塔的角色被拆分为一个上下文编码器和一个去噪器，二者需要不同的注意力模式。 视频历史以块因果方式逐帧编码，而未来规划则是联合去噪的，因此需要双向注意力。 与文本一起，这产生了三条 token 流。 在每一层，每条流对其自身的 token 进行自注意力计算，并对其所条件依赖的流进行交叉注意力计算：

sents.en: In the original Cosmos3, all video tokens attend to each other bidirectionally under a single mask.
sents.zh: 在原版 Cosmos3 中，所有视频 token 在单一掩码下进行双向相互注意力计算。

sents.en: In our implementation, however, the video tower’s role is split into a context encoder and a denoiser, which require distinct attention patterns.
sents.zh: 然而在我们的实现中，视频塔的角色被拆分为一个上下文编码器和一个去噪器，二者需要不同的注意力模式。

sents.en: Together with the text, this yields three token streams.
sents.zh: 与文本一起，这产生了三条 token 流。

sents.en: At every layer, each stream self-attends to its own tokens and cross-attends to the streams it is conditioned on:
sents.zh: 在每一层，每条流对其自身的 token 进行自注意力计算，并对其所条件依赖的流进行交叉注意力计算：

paragraphs.en: Text (text tower): self-attends causally, token by token. It carries the video metadata (resolution, aspect ratio, duration and frame rate), which also serves as an attention sink, and optional task instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 文本（文本塔）：按因果方式逐词元进行自注意力。 它承载视频元数据（分辨率、宽高比、时长和帧率），这些元数据同时也充当注意力锚点，此外还承载可选的任务指令。

sents.en: Text (text tower): self-attends causally, token by token.
sents.zh: 文本（文本塔）：按因果方式逐词元进行自注意力。

sents.en: It carries the video metadata (resolution, aspect ratio, duration and frame rate), which also serves as an attention sink, and optional task instructions.
sents.zh: 它承载视频元数据（分辨率、宽高比、时长和帧率），这些元数据同时也充当注意力锚点，此外还承载可选的任务指令。

paragraphs.en: History (context encoder): self-attends block-causally, i.e., bidirectionally within a frame and causally across frames. Cross-attends to the text.
paragraphs.zh: 历史（上下文编码器）：按块因果方式进行自注意力，即帧内双向、帧间因果。 对文本进行交叉注意力。

sents.en: Cross-attends to the text.
sents.zh: 对文本进行交叉注意力。

paragraphs.en: Plan (denoiser): self-attends bidirectionally within the plan. Cross-attends to the history and the text.
paragraphs.zh: 规划（去噪器）：在规划内部进行双向自注意力。 对历史和文本进行交叉注意力。

sents.zh: 规划（去噪器）：在规划内部进行双向自注意力。

sents.zh: 对历史和文本进行交叉注意力。

This is not only cumbersome to implement but also substantially slows down the FlexAttention kernel. We instead compute attention with a simpler mask for each source and merge the results as

sents.zh: 我们改为对每个源使用更简单的掩码分别计算注意力，然后将结果合并为

paragraphs.en: where the attention output o s o_{s} and the log-sum-exp LSE s \mathrm{LSE}_{s} are computed separately for each source s s . This merge is mathematically equivalent to standard scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) computed jointly over all sources. Keeping the sources separate makes the implementation of variable-length training and cached inference straightforward, at negligible overhead.

paragraphs.en: In video models such as Wan ( Wan Team, 2025 ) , the zeroth latent frame serves as the attention sink. In Cosmos3, whose mixture-of-transformers structure lets every video token attend to the text, the text tokens appear to play this role instead. Removing the text tokens greatly slowed down the finetuning. Provided that every video query can properly attend to the text metadata tokens, adapting the pretrained bidirectional model to block-causal attention is fast, taking fewer than 1,000 finetuning steps. On the other hand, removing the zeroth latent frame from the attention context of the denoiser caused only a small drop in performance if the history is long enough. The sliding-window attention described below therefore does not keep the zeroth latent frame; instead, every query always attends to the text.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Wan（Wan Team, 2025）等视频模型中，第零个潜在帧充当注意力汇聚点（attention sink）。 而在 Cosmos3 中，其混合变换器（mixture-of-transformers）结构让每个视频令牌都能关注文本，因此文本令牌似乎代替了这一角色。 移除文本令牌会大大减慢微调速度。 只要每个视频查询都能正确关注文本元数据令牌，将预训练的双向模型适配为块因果注意力就很快，只需不到 1,000 步微调。 另一方面，如果历史足够长，从去噪器的注意力上下文中移除第零个潜在帧只会导致性能小幅下降。 因此，下文描述的滑动窗口注意力不保留第零个潜在帧；相反，每个查询始终关注文本。

paragraphs.en: The right length for a plan is unknown in advance. Using too short plans or planning autoregressively with the shortest chunk the VAE allows (one latent frame, 0.2 s) produced poor plans, while 4 s is too long for open-loop execution. We therefore train a single model on a mixture of plan lengths from 0.2 s to 4 s. All frames of a prediction window share one diffusion time, and different windows draw diffusion time and noise independently. We also stochastically drop the text conditions of a subset of the prediction windows for unconditional generation and text-conditional classifier-free guidance ( Ho & Salimans, 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 计划的合适长度事先是未知的。 使用过短的计划，或以 VAE 允许的最小块（一个潜变量帧，0.2 秒）自回归地进行规划，都会产生糟糕的计划，而 4 秒对于开环执行来说又太长。 因此，我们在 0.2 秒到 4 秒的多种计划长度混合上训练单一模型。 一个预测窗口的所有帧共享同一个扩散时间，不同窗口则独立抽取扩散时间和噪声。 我们还会随机丢弃一部分预测窗口的文本条件，以实现无条件生成和基于文本条件的无分类器引导（Ho & Salimans, 2022）。

sents.zh: 计划的合适长度事先是未知的。

sents.zh: 我们还会随机丢弃一部分预测窗口的文本条件，以实现无条件生成和基于文本条件的无分类器引导（Ho & Salimans, 2022）。

paragraphs.en: Each training sample is a 32 s video clip, which is block-causally encoded as the clean history. Because this history is shared, we predict many prediction windows from a single video clip at once. This reuse of the context encoding is our key scaling knob. The learning signal comes only from the denoised tokens, so predicting many windows per video clip maximizes the learning signal per token. In our training setup, the prediction windows of each video clip span twice its 32 s length, totaling 64 s. Since the windows differ in position, length, diffusion time and noise, predicting the same video clip twice still provides new learning signal. In our gradient noise scale ( McCandlish et al., 2018 ) measurement at 30k steps, this double pass over a video clip reduced the gradient noise as much as an additional fresh video clip would. As the cost of encoding 32 s of history is amortized over all windows of the video clip, long-context training becomes affordable. Combined with sliding-window attention, this long-context training lets the planner roll out far beyond the training length, to about five minutes in our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 每个训练样本是一个 32 秒的视频片段，它以分块因果方式被编码为干净的历史。 由于这段历史是共享的，我们可以从一个视频片段中一次性预测出多个预测窗口。 这种对上下文编码的复用是我们关键的扩展手段。 学习信号仅来自被去噪的词元，因此每个视频片段预测多个窗口可以最大化每个词元的学习信号。 在我们的训练设置中，每个视频片段的预测窗口总跨度为其 32 秒长度的两倍，共计 64 秒。 由于各窗口在位置、长度、扩散时间和噪声上各不相同，对同一视频片段预测两次仍能提供新的学习信号。 在我们在 30k 步时的梯度噪声尺度（McCandlish et al., 2018）测量中，对视频片段的这种双重遍历所降低的梯度噪声，相当于再增加一个全新视频片段所能达到的效果。 由于编码 32 秒历史的成本被摊销到视频片段的所有窗口上，长上下文训练变得可行。 结合滑窗注意力，这种长上下文训练让规划器的推理可以远远超出训练长度，在我们的实验中达到约五分钟。

paragraphs.en: Compiling every transformer block is essential for training speed, and it requires static tensor shapes. FlexAttention makes this even more important: its block mask is built for a specific sequence shape, so any change of shape forces the mask and the attention kernel to be rebuilt and recompiled. While FlexAttention also supports dynamic-shape compilation, it is far less efficient than static compilation in both throughput and memory. We therefore keep every tensor shape fixed for training and express the variable prediction windows purely through the attention mask. We illustrate this in Figure 9 .
paragraphs.zh: 编译每个 transformer 块对训练速度至关重要，而这要求张量形状是静态的。 FlexAttention 让这一点变得更加重要：它的块掩码是为特定序列形状构建的，因此任何形状变化都会迫使掩码和注意力核被重新构建并重新编译。 虽然 FlexAttention 也支持动态形状编译，但无论在吞吐量还是内存方面，它的效率都远低于静态编译。 因此，我们在训练中保持所有张量形状固定，并纯粹通过注意力掩码来表达可变的预测窗口。 我们在图 9 中对此进行了说明。

sents.zh: 编译每个 transformer 块对训练速度至关重要，而这要求张量形状是静态的。

sents.en: FlexAttention makes this even more important: its block mask is built for a specific sequence shape, so any change of shape forces the mask and the attention kernel to be rebuilt and recompiled.

sents.en: We illustrate this in Figure 9 .
sents.zh: 我们在图 9 中对此进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: In our setup, each GPU processes 6,144 text tokens for the frozen text tower and one 32 s video clip as a fixed-length sequence of 9,600 clean video tokens (160 latent frames × \times 60 tokens), followed by 19,200 noisy plan tokens. All three numbers are multiples of FlexAttention’s 128-token block size, so the sequences align exactly with the 128 × 128 128\times 128 attention blocks for best efficiency. The number, lengths and positions of the prediction windows change at every step, but they only change the values of the boolean and integer window/frame id tensors that the mask function reads. The mask function for the video self-attention is:
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的配置中，每个 GPU 处理冻结文本塔的 6,144 个文本 token，以及一个 32 秒的视频片段（作为由 9,600 个干净视频 token（160 个潜在帧 × \times 60 个 token）组成的固定长度序列），其后是 19,200 个带噪声的计划 token。 这三个数字都是 FlexAttention 的 128-token 块大小的倍数，因此这些序列与 128 × 128 128\times 128 的注意力块精确对齐，以获得最佳效率。 预测窗口的数量、长度和位置在每一步都会变化，但它们只改变掩码函数所读取的布尔型和整数型窗口/帧 id 张量的值。 视频 self-attention 的掩码函数为：

paragraphs.en: We shard the video tower with Hybrid Sharded Data Parallel (HSDP) strategy on multiple nodes using Pytorch FSDP2 library ( Zhao et al., 2023b ) . Parameters are sharded within each 8-GPU node and replicated across nodes. We use activation checkpointing ( Chen et al., 2016 ) for each transformer block. On AMD MI350X GPUs (288 GB of memory) we do not use activation checkpointing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 PyTorch FSDP2 库（Zhao et al., 2023b）在多个节点上以混合分片数据并行（HSDP）策略对视频塔进行分片。 参数在每个 8-GPU 节点内分片，并在节点间复制。 我们对每个 transformer 块使用激活检查点（Chen et al., 2016）。 在 AMD MI350X GPU（288 GB 显存）上我们不使用激活检查点。

sents.en: We shard the video tower with Hybrid Sharded Data Parallel (HSDP) strategy on multiple nodes using Pytorch FSDP2 library ( Zhao et al., 2023b ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用 PyTorch FSDP2 库（Zhao et al., 2023b）在多个节点上以混合分片数据并行（HSDP）策略对视频塔进行分片。

sents.en: Parameters are sharded within each 8-GPU node and replicated across nodes.
sents.zh: 参数在每个 8-GPU 节点内分片，并在节点间复制。

sents.en: We use activation checkpointing ( Chen et al., 2016 ) for each transformer block.
sents.zh: 我们对每个 transformer 块使用激活检查点（Chen et al., 2016）。

sents.en: On AMD MI350X GPUs (288 GB of memory) we do not use activation checkpointing.
sents.zh: 在 AMD MI350X GPU（288 GB 显存）上我们不使用激活检查点。

paragraphs.en: We use BF16 precision for the computation. FSDP2 automatically downcasts the FP32 weights to BF16. The gradients are reduced across ranks in FP32. Numerically sensitive parts stay in FP32: the input patch projection, the timestep embedder, the velocity head, RMS/LayerNorm, the rotary embeddings, and the LSE attention merge. Training losses are computed in double precision. The frozen text tower and the VAE run in BF16. For pretraining, we additionally use FP8 mixed precision training with dynamic tensorwise scaling for the linear layers. Because we use sliding window attention (SWA), which is computed by an efficient block-sparse kernel, the training step is dominated by these matrix multiplications: FP8 speeds them up by about 1.6 × \times and a full training step by about 1.3 × \times . We found no evidence that FP8 training degrades the planning quality. FP8 can be disabled for cooldown or finetuning to reach a lower loss floor.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 BF16 精度进行计算。 FSDP2 会自动将 FP32 权重转换为 BF16。 梯度以 FP32 在各个 rank 之间进行归约。 数值敏感的部分保持 FP32：输入 patch 投影、时间步嵌入器、速度头、RMS/LayerNorm、旋转位置嵌入，以及 LSE 注意力合并。 训练损失以双精度计算。 冻结的文本塔和 VAE 以 BF16 运行。 在预训练中，我们还对线性层使用 FP8 混合精度训练，并采用动态张量级缩放。 由于我们使用滑动窗口注意力（SWA），它由高效的块稀疏核计算，训练步骤主要由这些矩阵乘法构成：FP8 能将其提速约 1.6 倍，并使整个训练步骤提速约 1.3 倍。 我们没有发现任何证据表明 FP8 训练会降低规划质量。 在冷却阶段或微调时可以禁用 FP8，以达到更低的损失下限。

sents.en: We use BF16 precision for the computation.
sents.zh: 我们使用 BF16 精度进行计算。

sents.en: FSDP2 automatically downcasts the FP32 weights to BF16.
sents.zh: FSDP2 会自动将 FP32 权重转换为 BF16。

sents.en: The gradients are reduced across ranks in FP32.
sents.zh: 梯度以 FP32 在各个 rank 之间进行归约。

sents.en: Numerically sensitive parts stay in FP32: the input patch projection, the timestep embedder, the velocity head, RMS/LayerNorm, the rotary embeddings, and the LSE attention merge.
sents.zh: 数值敏感的部分保持 FP32：输入 patch 投影、时间步嵌入器、速度头、RMS/LayerNorm、旋转位置嵌入，以及 LSE 注意力合并。

sents.en: Training losses are computed in double precision.
sents.zh: 训练损失以双精度计算。

sents.en: The frozen text tower and the VAE run in BF16.
sents.zh: 冻结的文本塔和 VAE 以 BF16 运行。

sents.en: For pretraining, we additionally use FP8 mixed precision training with dynamic tensorwise scaling for the linear layers.
sents.zh: 在预训练中，我们还对线性层使用 FP8 混合精度训练，并采用动态张量级缩放。

sents.en: Because we use sliding window attention (SWA), which is computed by an efficient block-sparse kernel, the training step is dominated by these matrix multiplications: FP8 speeds them up by about 1.6 × \times and a full training step by about 1.3 × \times .
sents.zh: 由于我们使用滑动窗口注意力（SWA），它由高效的块稀疏核计算，训练步骤主要由这些矩阵乘法构成：FP8 能将其提速约 1.6 倍，并使整个训练步骤提速约 1.3 倍。

sents.en: We found no evidence that FP8 training degrades the planning quality.
sents.zh: 我们没有发现任何证据表明 FP8 训练会降低规划质量。

sents.en: FP8 can be disabled for cooldown or finetuning to reach a lower loss floor.
sents.zh: 在冷却阶段或微调时可以禁用 FP8，以达到更低的损失下限。

paragraphs.en: We use AdamW ( Loshchilov & Hutter, 2017 ) with β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} and weight decay 0.01, a 1,000-step linear warm-up followed by a constant learning rate, gradient clipping at global norm 3.0, and an EMA of the weights with decay 0.9999. We chose AdamW because Cosmos3 was trained with it. We pretrained on VPT contractor dataset ( Baker et al., 2022 ) for 220k steps. As GPUs became available we grew the global batch from 8 to 32, raising the learning rate roughly with the square root of the batch size (Table 2 ), and ended with a 5k-step cooldown at a constant 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} . The run took roughly 4,700 H200 GPU-hours of training steps. The final pretrain checkpoint is the step-220k EMA.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 AdamW（Loshchilov & Hutter, 2017），其中 β = (0.9, 0.95) \beta=(0.9,0.95)，ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8}，权重衰减为 0.01，先进行 1,000 步线性预热后保持恒定学习率，梯度裁剪的全局范数阈值为 3.0，并使用衰减系数为 0.9999 的权重 EMA。 我们选择 AdamW 是因为 Cosmos3 是用它训练的。 我们在 VPT 承包商数据集（Baker et al., 2022）上进行了 220k 步的预训练。 随着 GPU 的增加，我们将全局批量大小从 8 增长到 32，学习率大致随批量大小的平方根提升（表 2），并在最后以恒定的 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} 进行了 5k 步的冷却。 该训练过程大约耗费了 4,700 个 H200 GPU 小时的训练步数。 最终的预训练检查点是第 220k 步的 EMA。

sents.en: We use AdamW ( Loshchilov & Hutter, 2017 ) with β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} and weight decay 0.01, a 1,000-step linear warm-up followed by a constant learning rate, gradient clipping at global norm 3.0, and an EMA of the weights with decay 0.9999.
sents.zh: 我们使用 AdamW（Loshchilov & Hutter, 2017），其中 β = (0.9, 0.95) \beta=(0.9,0.95)，ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8}，权重衰减为 0.01，先进行 1,000 步线性预热后保持恒定学习率，梯度裁剪的全局范数阈值为 3.0，并使用衰减系数为 0.9999 的权重 EMA。

sents.en: We chose AdamW because Cosmos3 was trained with it.
sents.zh: 我们选择 AdamW 是因为 Cosmos3 是用它训练的。

sents.en: We pretrained on VPT contractor dataset ( Baker et al., 2022 ) for 220k steps.
sents.zh: 我们在 VPT 承包商数据集（Baker et al., 2022）上进行了 220k 步的预训练。

sents.en: As GPUs became available we grew the global batch from 8 to 32, raising the learning rate roughly with the square root of the batch size (Table 2 ), and ended with a 5k-step cooldown at a constant 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} .
sents.zh: 随着 GPU 的增加，我们将全局批量大小从 8 增长到 32，学习率大致随批量大小的平方根提升（表 2），并在最后以恒定的 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} 进行了 5k 步的冷却。

sents.en: The run took roughly 4,700 H200 GPU-hours of training steps.
sents.zh: 该训练过程大约耗费了 4,700 个 H200 GPU 小时的训练步数。

sents.en: The final pretrain checkpoint is the step-220k EMA.
sents.zh: 最终的预训练检查点是第 220k 步的 EMA。

paragraphs.en: The VPT contractor dataset contains 2,945.7 hours of gameplay. We excluded one game-version subset (6.9; 271 recordings, 21.8 h) whose logged cursor coordinates are malformed; the coordinates are needed because the recordings do not show the cursor inside menus, so we draw it back into those frames. We also excluded low-quality data (7.9 h), leaving 55,919 recordings (2,916.0 h) for training. Training samples a recording uniformly and then a random 32 s clip from it. Frames are resized from 640 × 360 640\times 360 to 320 × 192 320\times 192 with bilinear interpolation and antialiasing. Over 220k steps, the planner saw about 98,000 hours of noisy video clips. The captions are generated from the videos with the Cosmos3-Nano VLM, as described in Appendix A.4 .
paragraphs.zh: VPT 承包商数据集包含 2,945.7 小时的游戏玩法。 我们排除了一个游戏版本子集（6.9；271 条录像，21.8 小时），其记录的光标坐标格式错误；由于录像中菜单内不显示光标，我们需要把这些坐标将光标重新绘制到相应的帧中。 我们还排除了低质量数据（7.9 小时），留下 55,919 条录像（2,916.0 小时）用于训练。 训练时先均匀抽取一条录像，然后从其中随机抽取一个 32 秒的片段。 帧从 640 × 360 640\times 360 双线性插值并抗锯齿地调整为 320 × 192 320\times 192。 在 22 万步中，规划器观看了约 98,000 小时的含噪视频片段。 这些字幕由 Cosmos3-Nano VLM 从视频中生成，具体见附录 A.4。

sents.en: The VPT contractor dataset contains 2,945.7 hours of gameplay.
sents.zh: VPT 承包商数据集包含 2,945.7 小时的游戏玩法。

sents.en: We excluded one game-version subset (6.9; 271 recordings, 21.8 h) whose logged cursor coordinates are malformed; the coordinates are needed because the recordings do not show the cursor inside menus, so we draw it back into those frames.
sents.zh: 我们排除了一个游戏版本子集（6.9；271 条录像，21.8 小时），其记录的光标坐标格式错误；由于录像中菜单内不显示光标，我们需要把这些坐标将光标重新绘制到相应的帧中。

sents.en: We also excluded low-quality data (7.9 h), leaving 55,919 recordings (2,916.0 h) for training.
sents.zh: 我们还排除了低质量数据（7.9 小时），留下 55,919 条录像（2,916.0 小时）用于训练。

sents.en: Training samples a recording uniformly and then a random 32 s clip from it.
sents.zh: 训练时先均匀抽取一条录像，然后从其中随机抽取一个 32 秒的片段。

sents.en: Frames are resized from 640 × 360 640\times 360 to 320 × 192 320\times 192 with bilinear interpolation and antialiasing.
sents.zh: 帧从 640 × 360 640\times 360 双线性插值并抗锯齿地调整为 320 × 192 320\times 192。

sents.en: Over 220k steps, the planner saw about 98,000 hours of noisy video clips.
sents.zh: 在 22 万步中，规划器观看了约 98,000 小时的含噪视频片段。

sents.en: The captions are generated from the videos with the Cosmos3-Nano VLM, as described in Appendix A.4 .
sents.zh: 这些字幕由 Cosmos3-Nano VLM 从视频中生成，具体见附录 A.4。

paragraphs.en: The pretrained video planner is finetuned for each downstream task with global batch 8 (16 to 32 for the Diamond planners) and an EMA decay of 0.9995. The number of steps varies from 10k to 50k depending on the task difficulty and the amount of available video data. The BASALT planners are trained only on human gameplay videos, without text instructions, with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , a 1k-step warm-up and cosine decay. BASALT episodes end when the player presses the Esc button, which is not visible in the video. We therefore finetune the video planner to predict a gray screen once the player presses the Esc button. The Diamond planners were finetuned with 16 MI350X GPUs on our curated split of human VPT gameplay, divided into subgoal clips (Appendix B.1.4 ). Text conditioning informs the planner of the current stage of the diamond tech tree.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练的视频规划器针对每个下游任务进行微调，全局批大小为 8（Diamond 规划器为 16 到 32），EMA 衰减率为 0.9995。 步数根据任务难度和可用视频数据的量从 10k 到 50k 不等。 BASALT 规划器仅使用人类游戏视频进行训练，不含文本指令，学习率为 10 − 5 10^{-5}，预热 1k 步并采用余弦衰减。 BASALT 回合在玩家按下 Esc 键时结束，而 Esc 键在视频中不可见。 因此，我们微调视频规划器，使其在玩家按下 Esc 键后预测灰屏。 Diamond 规划器使用 16 块 MI350X GPU 在我们精心整理的人类 VPT 游戏划分上进行微调，该划分被切分为子目标片段（附录 B.1.4）。 文本条件为规划器提供钻石科技树当前阶段的信息。

sents.en: The pretrained video planner is finetuned for each downstream task with global batch 8 (16 to 32 for the Diamond planners) and an EMA decay of 0.9995.
sents.zh: 预训练的视频规划器针对每个下游任务进行微调，全局批大小为 8（Diamond 规划器为 16 到 32），EMA 衰减率为 0.9995。

sents.en: The number of steps varies from 10k to 50k depending on the task difficulty and the amount of available video data.
sents.zh: 步数根据任务难度和可用视频数据的量从 10k 到 50k 不等。

sents.en: The BASALT planners are trained only on human gameplay videos, without text instructions, with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , a 1k-step warm-up and cosine decay.
sents.zh: BASALT 规划器仅使用人类游戏视频进行训练，不含文本指令，学习率为 10 − 5 10^{-5}，预热 1k 步并采用余弦衰减。

sents.en: BASALT episodes end when the player presses the Esc button, which is not visible in the video.
sents.zh: BASALT 回合在玩家按下 Esc 键时结束，而 Esc 键在视频中不可见。

sents.en: We therefore finetune the video planner to predict a gray screen once the player presses the Esc button.
sents.zh: 因此，我们微调视频规划器，使其在玩家按下 Esc 键后预测灰屏。

sents.en: The Diamond planners were finetuned with 16 MI350X GPUs on our curated split of human VPT gameplay, divided into subgoal clips (Appendix B.1.4 ).
sents.zh: Diamond 规划器使用 16 块 MI350X GPU 在我们精心整理的人类 VPT 游戏划分上进行微调，该划分被切分为子目标片段（附录 B.1.4）。

sents.en: Text conditioning informs the planner of the current stage of the diamond tech tree.
sents.zh: 文本条件为规划器提供钻石科技树当前阶段的信息。

paragraphs.en: At inference, the planner keeps the keys and values of only the most recent 12 s of observations in a fixed-size ring-buffer cache. Each newly observed frame is encoded once by the context encoder using this cache. This new frame replaces the oldest frame in the cache, which no query can attend to anymore because of the sliding window. To plan, the denoiser generates the next 1.6 s future by attending to the last 8 s of the cache and optionally to the control-level caption. Because the cache size never grows, every plan costs the same and the model can be compiled with static shape. We illustrate this in Figure 10 .
paragraphs.zh: 在推理时，规划器在固定大小的环形缓冲区缓存中仅保留最近12秒观测值的键和值。 每个新观测到的帧由上下文编码器利用该缓存仅编码一次。 这一新帧会替换缓存中最旧的帧，由于滑动窗口的存在，任何查询都无法再关注该最旧帧。 在规划时，去噪器通过关注缓存中最后8秒的内容以及可选的控制级描述来生成未来1.6秒的内容。 由于缓存大小永不增长，每次规划的开销相同，且模型可以用静态形状进行编译。 我们在图10中对此进行了说明。

sents.en: At inference, the planner keeps the keys and values of only the most recent 12 s of observations in a fixed-size ring-buffer cache.
sents.zh: 在推理时，规划器在固定大小的环形缓冲区缓存中仅保留最近12秒观测值的键和值。

sents.en: Each newly observed frame is encoded once by the context encoder using this cache.
sents.zh: 每个新观测到的帧由上下文编码器利用该缓存仅编码一次。

sents.en: This new frame replaces the oldest frame in the cache, which no query can attend to anymore because of the sliding window.
sents.zh: 这一新帧会替换缓存中最旧的帧，由于滑动窗口的存在，任何查询都无法再关注该最旧帧。

sents.en: To plan, the denoiser generates the next 1.6 s future by attending to the last 8 s of the cache and optionally to the control-level caption.
sents.zh: 在规划时，去噪器通过关注缓存中最后8秒的内容以及可选的控制级描述来生成未来1.6秒的内容。

sents.en: Because the cache size never grows, every plan costs the same and the model can be compiled with static shape.
sents.zh: 由于缓存大小永不增长，每次规划的开销相同，且模型可以用静态形状进行编译。

sents.en: We illustrate this in Figure 10 .
sents.zh: 我们在图10中对此进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: Plans are sampled with the second-order UniPC solver ( Zhao et al., 2023a ) for 20 steps with a time shift of 3. We quantize the linear layers of the video tower to FP8 with per-tensor dynamic scaling, which makes planning 1.43 × 1.43\times faster than BF16 on an H200. With 20 solver steps and autoguidance, the planner generates about 4.2 s of video per second of computation on a single H200.
paragraphs.zh: 计划采用二阶 UniPC 求解器（Zhao et al., 2023a）采样，共 20 步，时间偏移为 3。 我们将视频塔的线性层量化为 FP8，并使用逐张量动态缩放，这使得规划在 H200 上比 BF16 快 1.43 × 1.43\times。 在 20 步求解器与自引导的设置下，规划器在单块 H200 上每秒计算可生成约 4.2 秒的视频。

sents.en: Plans are sampled with the second-order UniPC solver ( Zhao et al., 2023a ) for 20 steps with a time shift of 3.
sents.zh: 计划采用二阶 UniPC 求解器（Zhao et al., 2023a）采样，共 20 步，时间偏移为 3。

sents.en: We quantize the linear layers of the video tower to FP8 with per-tensor dynamic scaling, which makes planning 1.43 × 1.43\times faster than BF16 on an H200.
sents.zh: 我们将视频塔的线性层量化为 FP8，并使用逐张量动态缩放，这使得规划在 H200 上比 BF16 快 1.43 × 1.43\times。

sents.en: With 20 solver steps and autoguidance, the planner generates about 4.2 s of video per second of computation on a single H200.
sents.zh: 在 20 步求解器与自引导的设置下，规划器在单块 H200 上每秒计算可生成约 4.2 秒的视频。

paragraphs.en: We use two forms of task-aware guidance. For the BASALT tasks, we use a variant of autoguidance ( Karras et al., 2024 ) , where the positive model is the finetuned planner and the negative model is a planner trained on broader, less task-specific data, such as its parent before task finetuning; we use a guidance scale of 1.5. For Sec. 4.1.3 and Sec. 4.1.2 , we use text classifier-free guidance ( Ho & Salimans, 2022 ) with a scale of 7. For Sec. 4.1.2 , the text consists of one of 16 subgoal captions from log to diamond, chosen by the subgoal task planner (Appendix B.1.5 ). The conditional and unconditional branches share the cached history, so guidance doubles only the denoiser’s computation. We find that task-aware guidance is crucial for goal persistence. Without it, the planner often abandons the current goal after repeated failures. As a result, it may skip necessary steps and move on to the next subgoal before completing the current one. Task-aware classifier-free guidance effectively suppresses repeated mistakes and strengthens adherence to the intended goal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用两种形式的任务感知引导。 对于 BASALT 任务，我们使用自动引导（autoguidance）的一种变体（Karras et al., 2024），其中正模型是经过微调的规划器，负模型是在更广泛、任务特异性更低的数据上训练的规划器，例如任务微调之前的父模型；我们使用的引导比例为 1.5。 对于第 4.1.3 节和第 4.1.2 节，我们使用文本无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）（Ho & Salimans, 2022），比例为 7。 对于第 4.1.2 节，文本由从原木到钻石的 16 个子目标描述之一组成，由子目标任务规划器选择（附录 B.1.5）。 条件分支和无条件分支共享缓存的历史记录，因此引导只会使去噪器的计算量增加一倍。 我们发现任务感知引导对于目标持续性至关重要。 没有它，规划器在反复失败后常常会放弃当前目标。 结果，它可能会跳过必要的步骤，在完成当前子目标之前就转向下一个子目标。 任务感知无分类器引导能有效抑制重复的错误，并加强对预期目标的坚持。

sents.zh: 我们使用两种形式的任务感知引导。
