paragraphs.en: We captioned the VPT corpus with the vision-language model of Cosmos3-Nano ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , served offline by vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) with JSON-schema-constrained decoding (temperature 0.7, top- p p 0.8, top- k k 20). We aim for text that is both descriptive , grounded in what is visible, and instructional , phrased the way a user would command an agent. We therefore generate captions in three stages. A strictly factual stage comes first, and later stages only rephrase or group its output.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Cosmos3-Nano（NVIDIA，2026）的视觉-语言模型为 VPT 语料库生成描述，该模型由 vLLM（Kwon et al.，2023）离线服务，并采用 JSON 模式约束解码（温度 0.7，top-p 0.8，top-k 20）。 我们旨在生成既具描述性、又立足于可见内容、且具有指导性的文本，其措辞方式如同用户向智能体下达指令。 因此，我们分三个阶段生成描述。 首先进行一个严格基于事实的阶段，后续阶段仅对其输出进行改写或分组。

sents.zh: 我们使用 Cosmos3-Nano（NVIDIA，2026）的视觉-语言模型为 VPT 语料库生成描述，该模型由 vLLM（Kwon et al.，2023）离线服务，并采用 JSON 模式约束解码（温度 0.7，top-p 0.8，top-k 20）。

sents.en: We therefore generate captions in three stages.
sents.zh: 因此，我们分三个阶段生成描述。

sents.en: A strictly factual stage comes first, and later stages only rephrase or group its output.
sents.zh: 首先进行一个严格基于事实的阶段，后续阶段仅对其输出进行改写或分组。

paragraphs.en: Descriptions. The model watches overlapping windows of every video at four temporal scales. These are 8 s windows every 4 s at 4 fps, 24 s windows every 12 s at 1 fps, and 64 s windows every 32 s at 0.5 fps, all at 192 × 320 192\times 320 . The fourth scale is short windows at full 640 × 360 640\times 360 resolution centered on salient moments (attacks, opening a menu, jumps, sharp turns, climbs and descents of at least four blocks). The model is not told why a window was chosen. The model lists up to six atomic, intent-free descriptions per window, each with a start and end time.
paragraphs.zh: 描述。 模型以四个时间尺度观察每个视频的重叠窗口。 这些尺度是：以 4 fps 每 4 秒取 8 秒窗口，以 1 fps 每 12 秒取 24 秒窗口，以 0.5 fps 每 32 秒取 64 秒窗口，分辨率均为 192 × 320 192\times 320。 第四个尺度是以 640 × 360 640\times 360 全分辨率、围绕显著时刻（攻击、打开菜单、跳跃、急转弯、至少四个方块的攀升与下降）选取的短窗口。 模型不会被告知某个窗口为何被选中。 模型为每个窗口列出最多六条原子化的、不含意图的描述，每条带有开始和结束时间。

sents.en: Descriptions.
sents.zh: 描述。

sents.en: The model watches overlapping windows of every video at four temporal scales.
sents.zh: 模型以四个时间尺度观察每个视频的重叠窗口。

sents.en: These are 8 s windows every 4 s at 4 fps, 24 s windows every 12 s at 1 fps, and 64 s windows every 32 s at 0.5 fps, all at 192 × 320 192\times 320 .
sents.zh: 这些尺度是：以 4 fps 每 4 秒取 8 秒窗口，以 1 fps 每 12 秒取 24 秒窗口，以 0.5 fps 每 32 秒取 64 秒窗口，分辨率均为 192 × 320 192\times 320。

sents.en: The fourth scale is short windows at full 640 × 360 640\times 360 resolution centered on salient moments (attacks, opening a menu, jumps, sharp turns, climbs and descents of at least four blocks).
sents.zh: 第四个尺度是以 640 × 360 640\times 360 全分辨率、围绕显著时刻（攻击、打开菜单、跳跃、急转弯、至少四个方块的攀升与下降）选取的短窗口。

sents.en: The model is not told why a window was chosen.
sents.zh: 模型不会被告知某个窗口为何被选中。

sents.en: The model lists up to six atomic, intent-free descriptions per window, each with a start and end time.
sents.zh: 模型为每个窗口列出最多六条原子化的、不含意图的描述，每条带有开始和结束时间。

paragraphs.en: Instructions. Batches of 40 descriptions, together with the video covering their time span, are rewritten one-to-one into imperative instructions. Each instruction inherits the description’s time span.
paragraphs.zh: 指令。 将每批 40 条描述连同覆盖其时间跨度的视频一起，一一对应地改写为祈使式指令。 每条指令继承该描述的时间跨度。

sents.en: Instructions.
sents.zh: 指令。

sents.en: Batches of 40 descriptions, together with the video covering their time span, are rewritten one-to-one into imperative instructions.
sents.zh: 将每批 40 条描述连同覆盖其时间跨度的视频一起，一一对应地改写为祈使式指令。

sents.en: Each instruction inherits the description’s time span.
sents.zh: 每条指令继承该描述的时间跨度。

paragraphs.en: Tasks. From the video duration and up to 110 descriptions evenly distributed across time, the model partitions the whole recording into 1–8 consecutive task segments and infers the intent that makes each segment’s behavior coherent. We run this stage five times per video with different seeds, which yields five alternative task partitions.
paragraphs.zh: 任务。 从视频时长开始，模型将整段录像划分为最多 110 个均匀分布在时间轴上的描述，并在此基础上把整段录像划分为 1–8 个连续的任务片段，同时推断出让每个片段的行为保持连贯的意图。 我们对每个视频使用不同的随机种子运行该阶段五次，从而得到五种可供选择的任务划分方案。

sents.en: Tasks.
sents.zh: 任务。

sents.en: From the video duration and up to 110 descriptions evenly distributed across time, the model partitions the whole recording into 1–8 consecutive task segments and infers the intent that makes each segment’s behavior coherent.
sents.zh: 从视频时长开始，模型将整段录像划分为最多 110 个均匀分布在时间轴上的描述，并在此基础上把整段录像划分为 1–8 个连续的任务片段，同时推断出让每个片段的行为保持连贯的意图。

sents.zh: 我们对每个视频使用不同的随机种子运行该阶段五次，从而得到五种可供选择的任务划分方案。

paragraphs.en: The description stage took 4.6 hours on 32 H200 GPUs, plus 1.2 hours for the coarsest scale.
paragraphs.zh: 描述阶段在 32 块 H200 GPU 上花费了 4.6 小时，加上最粗尺度所需的 1.2 小时。

paragraphs.en: The instructions of the three stages, verbatim:
paragraphs.zh: 三个阶段的指令，逐字如下：

paragraphs.en: We clean the generated captions with simple rules:
paragraphs.zh: 我们用简单的规则清洗生成的字幕：

paragraphs.en: decoding is constrained to a JSON schema;
paragraphs.zh: 解码被约束为 JSON 模式；

paragraphs.en: description times are clamped to their window;
paragraphs.zh: 描述时间会被限制在其窗口内；

paragraphs.en: empty or zero-length items are dropped, 1.5% of descriptions in the rewrite;
paragraphs.zh: 空项或零长度项会被丢弃，改写中 1.5% 的描述；

paragraphs.en: task boundaries are closed into an exact partition on the frame clock.
paragraphs.zh: 任务边界在帧时钟上被封闭为一个精确的划分。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 summarizes the corpus: 58,121 videos (2,943 h), about 28M captions and 489M tokens. Descriptions and instructions overlap heavily by design. Their total span is about 6 × \times the video duration, so every moment is described several times at several scales. Each task partition tiles its video exactly. 94.6% of task intents and 84.9% of instructions are unique strings.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 总结了该语料库：58,121 个视频（2,943 小时），约 2800 万条字幕和 4.89 亿个词元。 描述与指令在设计上高度重叠。 它们的总时长约为视频时长的 6 × \times 倍，因此每个时刻都会在多个尺度上被多次描述。 每个任务分区恰好铺满其对应的视频。94.6% 的任务意图和 84.9% 的指令是唯一字符串。

paragraphs.en: Architecture. Unless noted otherwise, the V2A model for Minecraft uses an 80-million parameter V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-B model ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) as a backbone. The model takes up to 8 history frames and 16 future frames as input, and predicts a chunk of up to 16 actions. The V2A predicts keyboard and mouse actions from the MineRL 1.0 action space ( Guss et al., 2019 ) . The button actions are parameterized as categorical distributions, following the factorized button representation of VPT. The x x and y y offsets for mouse movement are parameterized as a 2D vector. For the diamond task, the final self-improving model is retrained with the larger V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L encoder (Appendix B.1.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 架构。 除非另有说明，Minecraft 使用的 V2A 模型以 8000 万参数的 V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-B 模型（Assran et al., 2025；Mur-Labadia et al., 2026）作为主干网络。 该模型最多接收 8 个历史帧和 16 个未来帧作为输入，并预测最多包含 16 个动作的动作块。 V2A 根据 MineRL 1.0 动作空间（Guss et al., 2019）预测键盘和鼠标动作。 按键动作参照 VPT 的因式分解按键表示，被参数化为类别分布。 鼠标移动的 xx 和 yy 偏移量被参数化为一个二维向量。 对于钻石任务，最终的自我改进模型使用更大的 V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L 编码器进行重新训练（附录 B.1.6）。

paragraphs.en: Exploration Noise. Exploration noise helps the agent learn novel interactions with the environment. However, if the noise is too high frequency, it may harm performance. Real-world actions are typically low frequency—a player will often repeat the same action, such as moving forward, over several time steps. We generate such low frequency exploration noise with random walks. We inject Brownian motion with standard deviation 1.0 for mouse exploration, and add noise corresponding to random walks of button presses for discrete actions.
paragraphs.zh: 探索噪声。 探索噪声帮助智能体学习与环境的全新交互。 然而，如果噪声频率过高，可能会损害性能。 真实世界的动作通常是低频率的——玩家往往会在多个时间步内重复相同的动作，例如持续向前移动。 我们通过随机游走生成这种低频率的探索噪声。 我们为鼠标探索注入标准差为 1.0 的布朗运动，并为离散动作添加对应于按键随机游走的噪声。

paragraphs.en: Our method and the BASALT baselines were evaluated using the 11 world seeds from the BASALT 2022 challenge ( Milani et al., 2022 ) . Specific task prompts and environment settings can be found on the MineRL website . The BASALT 2022 retrospective report ( Milani et al., 2022 ) contains comprehensive details and code describing the winning solutions to the challenge: GoUp, UniTeam, KAIROS, and others.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法与 BASALT 基线均使用 BASALT 2022 挑战赛（Milani et al., 2022）的 11 个世界种子进行评估。 具体的任务提示与环境设置可在 MineRL 网站上找到。 BASALT 2022 回顾报告（Milani et al., 2022）包含描述该挑战赛获胜方案的全面细节与代码：GoUp、UniTeam、KAIROS 等。

sents.en: Our method and the BASALT baselines were evaluated using the 11 world seeds from the BASALT 2022 challenge ( Milani et al., 2022 ) .
sents.zh: 我们的方法与 BASALT 基线均使用 BASALT 2022 挑战赛（Milani et al., 2022）的 11 个世界种子进行评估。

sents.en: Specific task prompts and environment settings can be found on the MineRL website .

sents.en: The BASALT 2022 retrospective report ( Milani et al., 2022 ) contains comprehensive details and code describing the winning solutions to the challenge: GoUp, UniTeam, KAIROS, and others.
sents.zh: BASALT 2022 回顾报告（Milani et al., 2022）包含描述该挑战赛获胜方案的全面细节与代码：GoUp、UniTeam、KAIROS 等。

paragraphs.en: While the BASALT criteria are intentionally fuzzy, we evaluate each method on objective criteria for fairness. For FindCave, success is granted when the agent enters a cave or ravine. On MakeWaterfall, we report success as when the player successfully places a water bucket, and ends the episode facing the waterfall to “take a picture”. The waterfall must be in view during the episode’s final frame for success to be granted. Because Mirror does not rely on action labels and its video planner makes the decisions, the planner also decides when an episode ends: it predicts a gray screen where human players pressed Esc. On MakeWaterfall, we therefore treat a gray screen predicted by the video planner, or reaching the time limit, as the agent pressing Esc. As the only exception, we ignore gray screens predicted before the agent has given one second of movement input (about four blocks of walking), to filter out false positives at the very start of an episode.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 BASALT 标准刻意比较模糊，但为了公平起见，我们依据客观标准评估每种方法。 在 FindCave 任务中，当智能体进入洞穴或峡谷时即判定成功。 在 MakeWaterfall 任务中，我们以玩家成功放置水桶，并在回合结束时面向瀑布以“拍照”作为成功的判定标准。 瀑布必须出现在回合最后一帧的画面中，才能判定成功。 由于 Mirror 不依赖动作标签，而是由其视频规划器做出决策，因此回合何时结束也由规划器决定：它会预测出人类玩家按下 Esc 时出现的灰色画面。 因此在 MakeWaterfall 任务中，我们将视频规划器预测出灰色画面或到达时间上限，视为智能体按下了 Esc。 唯一的例外是，我们忽略在智能体给出第一秒移动输入（约走四个方块）之前预测到的灰色画面，以过滤掉回合开始时出现的误报。

paragraphs.en: The following subsections describe the diamond experiments of Section 4.1.2 : the video planner’s data (Appendix B.1.4 ), the subgoal task planner (Appendix B.1.5 ), the training of the self-improving V2A model (Appendix B.1.6 ), and the post-processing of the videos (Appendix B.1.7 ). Here we summarize what supervision enters the pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 以下小节描述第 4.1.2 节中的 diamond 实验：视频规划器的数据（附录 B.1.4）、子目标任务规划器（附录 B.1.5）、自我改进的 V2A 模型的训练（附录 B.1.6），以及视频的后处理（附录 B.1.7）。 这里我们总结有哪些监督信息进入该流程。

sents.en: Here we summarize what supervision enters the pipeline.
sents.zh: 这里我们总结有哪些监督信息进入该流程。

paragraphs.en: Neither the VP nor the self-improving V2A model is trained on expert actions, rewards, or privileged game state; the only actions the self-improving V2A model learns from are the ones the agent executed itself. The VPT action and event logs come in at two places. First, as the mouse cursor is missing inside menus in the VPT recordings, we draw it using the logged mouse position, as VPT’s own data loader does ( Baker et al., 2022 ) . This only restores what the player saw on screen. Second, the logs help curate the VP’s data. They direct the captioning VLM to salient moments (Appendix A.4 ) and mark where each subgoal of the diamond task happens (Appendix B.1.4 ). This makes up for the limited capacity of our relatively small captioning model, the roughly 8B-parameter VLM of Cosmos3-Nano ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , which lacks Minecraft-specific domain knowledge. We believe that stronger VLMs with broader domain knowledge will make these log-based aids unnecessary. During rollouts, the subgoal task planner reads the agent’s inventory, health, and whether a GUI is open. These state inputs are used only to adjust the VP’s behavior by modulating its text prompt and guidance scale.
paragraphs.zh: VP 和自我改进的 V2A 模型都没有在专家动作、奖励或特权游戏状态上训练；自我改进的 V2A 模型从中学习的唯一动作是智能体自己执行的动作。 VPT 的动作和事件日志在两处被使用。 首先，由于 VPT 录像中菜单内缺失鼠标光标，我们像 VPT 自己的数据加载器那样（Baker et al., 2022），利用记录的鼠标位置来绘制它。 这只是还原玩家在屏幕上看到的内容。 其次，这些日志有助于整理 VP 的数据。 它们将字幕生成的 VLM 引向显著时刻（Appendix A.4），并标记钻石任务每个子目标发生的位置（Appendix B.1.4）。 这弥补了我们相对较小的字幕生成模型（Cosmos3-Nano 的大约 80 亿参数 VLM（NVIDIA, 2026））能力有限、缺乏《我的世界》特定领域知识的不足。 我们相信，拥有更广泛领域知识的更强 VLM 将使这些基于日志的辅助手段变得不再必要。 在 rollout 过程中，子目标任务规划器会读取智能体的物品栏、生命值以及是否有 GUI 打开。 这些状态输入仅用于通过调节 VP 的文本提示和引导比例来调整其行为。

paragraphs.en: Our VP was finetuned only on human gameplay from the VPT contractor recordings ( Baker et al., 2022 ) . Starting from the video planner pretrained on the VPT dataset (Appendix A ), we first finetune it for 30k steps on gameplay rendered with the post-processing of Appendix B.1.7 , so that the planner gets used to the new cursor and hotbar. We then post-train it for about 50k steps on a curated VPT subset split into subgoals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 VP 仅在来自 VPT 承包商录制内容（Baker et al., 2022）的人类游玩数据上进行了微调。 从在 VPT 数据集上预训练的视频规划器（附录 A）出发，我们首先使用附录 B.1.7 的后处理渲染的游戏画面对其微调 3 万步，使规划器适应新的光标和快捷栏。 然后我们在一个划分成子目标的精选 VPT 子集上对其后训练约 5 万步。

sents.zh: 我们的 VP 仅在来自 VPT 承包商录制内容（Baker et al., 2022）的人类游玩数据上进行了微调。

sents.en: We then post-train it for about 50k steps on a curated VPT subset split into subgoals.
sents.zh: 然后我们在一个划分成子目标的精选 VPT 子集上对其后训练约 5 万步。

paragraphs.en: We split the task into 16 subgoals, from log to diamond (Figure 11 ). In the 2,212 hours of VPT data versions 6.10 to 10, an inventory gain in the recorder log marks when a subgoal is completed, and a game statistic tells whether the item was mined, crafted, placed, or taken from a furnace. Each subgoal interval covers the activity leading up to the gain, such as the last run of attacks before a mined block or the time since the crafting screen opened. Training clips of 32 s lie at least half inside an interval of their subgoal, and subgoals are sampled in proportion to the fourth root of their footage, which roughly balances them. The resulting clips span 665 hours, 403 of which fall inside subgoal intervals. Footage is plentiful for gathering (153 hours for cobblestone, 126 for log, and 68 for iron ore) but scarce for everything else: 9.5 hours for diamond and 2.7–12.3 hours for each crafting, placing, or smelting subgoal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将任务拆分为 16 个子目标，从原木到钻石（图 11）。 在 VPT 数据第 6.10 版到第 10 版共 2,212 小时的数据中，记录器日志里的物品栏获得事件标志着某个子目标的完成，而游戏统计数据则说明该物品是被开采、合成、放置，还是从熔炉中取出。 每个子目标区间涵盖通向该获得事件的活动，例如在被开采方块前的最后一轮攻击，或自合成界面打开以来的时间。 长度为 32 秒的训练片段至少有一半位于其子目标的区间之内，且各子目标按其素材时长的四次方根比例进行采样，从而大致实现均衡。 所得片段总计 665 小时，其中 403 小时落在子目标区间之内。 采集类素材十分充足（圆石 153 小时、原木 126 小时、铁矿石 68 小时），但其余一切都很稀缺：钻石仅 9.5 小时，而每个合成、放置或冶炼子目标仅为 2.7–12.3 小时。

paragraphs.en: Each subgoal has a single caption of the form “Current subgoal: {item}. {instruction}”, for example “Current subgoal: stone pickaxe. Craft a stone pickaxe using cobblestone and sticks in the crafting grid.” Captions carry no quantities, since the task planner decides when to move on. Prediction windows inside a subgoal interval get its caption, and some windows are left without text to train the unconditional branch for classifier-free guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 每个子目标都有一条格式为「当前子目标：{item}。{instruction}」的单条说明文字，例如「当前子目标：石镐。在工作台中用圆石和木棍合成一把石镝。」 说明文字不包含数量信息，因为何时进入下一步由任务规划器决定。 子目标区间内的预测窗口会获得该子目标的说明文字，同时部分窗口不提供文本，用于训练无分类器引导所需的无条件分支。

paragraphs.en: Dreamer V4 ( Hafner et al., 2025b ) also conditions its agent on subgoals, prompting a one-hot task input through a fixed sequence of 25 tasks during evaluation. As the code is not public, we wrote our own heuristic subgoal planner (Figure 11 ). Once per plan, it picks the first unmet subgoal by chaining backward from the diamond through the recipes, given the current inventory. It collects spare wood before going underground and enough cobblestone for both the stone pickaxe and the furnace, and it places a crafting table before every 3 × \times 3 craft and picks it up afterwards, since it cannot tell whether an earlier table is still within reach. Its only inputs are the inventory counts, the health, and whether a GUI is open. Dreamer V4 does not say how it decides that a subgoal is done, but its task set includes open_crafting_table and open_furnace , and its evaluation prompts include use_stone_pickaxe and use_iron_pickaxe (Tables 4 and 6 of Hafner et al. (2025b) ). None of these can be read from the inventory or a GUI flag. Our planner uses no such game events and no learned classifier. The task planner’s only outputs are the subgoal caption and the text CFG scale of the video planner. The V2A model never sees either.
paragraphs.zh: Dreamer V4（Hafner 等，2025b）同样以子目标作为智能体的条件，在评估期间通过固定的 25 个任务序列提示一个独热任务输入。 由于其代码未公开，我们自行编写了一个启发式子目标规划器（图 11）。 在每次规划中，它根据当前物品栏，从钻石出发沿配方链向后回溯，选取第一个未满足的子目标。 它在进入地下之前收集备用木材，并收集足够圆石以同时用于石镐和熔炉；由于它无法判断先前放置的工作台是否仍在可及范围内，它在每次 3 × \times 3 合成之前放置一个工作台，之后再将其捡起。 它唯一的输入是物品栏数量、生命值以及是否有图形界面（GUI）处于打开状态。 Dreamer V4 没有说明它如何判定某个子目标已完成，但其任务集合包含 open_crafting_table 和 open_furnace，且其评估提示包含 use_stone_pickaxe 和 use_iron_pickaxe（Hafner 等（2025b）的表 4 和表 6）。 这些都无法从物品栏或 GUI 标志中读取。 我们的规划器不使用任何此类游戏事件，也不使用任何学习到的分类器。 任务规划器唯一的输出是子目标描述文本和视频规划器的文本 CFG 尺度。 V2A 模型两者都从未见到过。

sents.zh: 这些都无法从物品栏或 GUI 标志中读取。

sents.en: Our planner uses no such game events and no learned classifier.
sents.zh: 我们的规划器不使用任何此类游戏事件，也不使用任何学习到的分类器。

sents.en: The task planner’s only outputs are the subgoal caption and the text CFG scale of the video planner.
sents.zh: 任务规划器唯一的输出是子目标描述文本和视频规划器的文本 CFG 尺度。

sents.en: The V2A model never sees either.
sents.zh: V2A 模型两者都从未见到过。

paragraphs.en: The text CFG scale is 7 by default. After the agent takes damage, it drops to 0.01 until the lost health is repaid at 1 HP per 1.5 s, so the video planner falls back on what players typically do when hurt, e.g., fight or flee. In a fraction of the training episodes, it also oscillates between 7 and 1/7 on the subgoals where the agent stalls most (cobblestone, iron ore, loading the furnace, iron ingot, and diamond). Evaluation never uses this rule.
paragraphs.zh: 文本 CFG scale 默认为 7。 智能体受到伤害后，该值降至 0.01，直到损失的生命值以每 1.5 秒恢复 1 点生命值的速度补回，因此视频规划器会退而采用玩家受伤时通常会做的行为，例如战斗或逃跑。 在一小部分训练回合中，该值还会在智能体最容易停滞的子目标（圆石、铁矿石、装填熔炉、铁锭和钻石）上在 7 和 1/7 之间振荡。 评估从不使用该规则。

paragraphs.en: The self-improving V2A model starts from a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-B encoder ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) with freshly initialized action heads and learns online in 56 parallel environments. Training batches are sampled uniformly from a replay buffer that keeps the latest four in-game minutes of experience per environment. We keep the update-to-data ratio at about 1, lower than in typical sample-efficient RL methods that update many times per environment step. Our V2A objective has much lower variance than RL objectives, so the model learns efficiently from each transition, and compute is better spent on exploring new parts of the task than on replaying old experience. The V2A model’s observations pass through a Wan2.2 VAE round trip, so that they look like the generated plans. Online training ran for 45k updates at batch 224, over 140 in-game hours.
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进的 V2A 模型从一个预训练的 V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-B 编码器（Assran et al., 2025；Mur-Labadia et al., 2026）出发，动作头为全新初始化，并在 56 个并行环境中在线学习。 训练批次从回放缓冲区中均匀采样，该缓冲区为每个环境保留最近四分钟游戏内时长的经验。 我们将更新与数据比保持在 1 左右，低于典型的样本高效强化学习方法在每个环境步中多次更新的比例。 我们的 V2A 目标的方差远低于强化学习目标，因此模型能从每条转移中高效学习，将算力更好地用于探索任务的新部分，而不是重放旧经验。 V2A 模型的观测会经过 Wan2.2 VAE 的往返处理，使其看起来与生成的规划一致。 在线训练以批量大小 224 运行了 45k 次更新，累计超过 140 游戏内小时。

sents.zh: 我们将更新与数据比保持在 1 左右，低于典型的样本高效强化学习方法在每个环境步中多次更新的比例。

sents.en: Our V2A objective has much lower variance than RL objectives, so the model learns efficiently from each transition, and compute is better spent on exploring new parts of the task than on replaying old experience.
sents.zh: 我们的 V2A 目标的方差远低于强化学习目标，因此模型能从每条转移中高效学习，将算力更好地用于探索任务的新部分，而不是重放旧经验。

sents.zh: V2A 模型的观测会经过 Wan2.2 VAE 的往返处理，使其看起来与生成的规划一致。

paragraphs.en: Exploration comes from two sources. The first is behavioral: lowering the text CFG scale pulls the plans toward the unconditional VP, which reproduces the exploratory and recovery behavior of human players. The second is action noise (Appendix B.1.1 ), whose main role is to keep a minimum probability on every action. Actions with little or no visible effect, such as mouse clicks in an empty space, easily collapse to a single mode. The V2A model trains on its own executed actions and this results in a self-reinforcing collapse. The action exploration noise keeps a minimal floor probability, preventing any action from being starved. Note that both kinds of exploration are double-edged: they diversify the data, but they also slow the agent down and lower its chance of reaching deep subgoals. We therefore explore mostly at the frontier, where the agent is believed to be stuck. In the last four minutes before each milestone deadline, the guidance scale oscillates between 7 and 0.05 on a log scale and the action noise turns on and off, each with a random period of 0.5 to 3 minutes. In a fraction of the training episodes, the task planner also oscillates the guidance scale on stall-prone subgoals (Figure 11 ). Action noise is applied only during these exploration periods and the staggered entry below, and the V2A model trains on the noisy actions that were actually executed, rather than the clean actions it predicted. Even a small noise at this frontier is enough to prevent self-reinforcing collapse. Finally, if all environments started their episodes at once, the replay would be dominated by whichever subgoal they were all working on. To balance the subgoals, we stagger the start of training: environment g ∈ { 0 , … , 55 } g\in\{0,\dots,55\} first plays an unconditional world with action noise for ( g + 1 2 ) ⋅ 32 (g+\tfrac{1}{2})\cdot 32 s (16 s to 29.6 min) before its first task episode, which spreads the environments across the task. This staggered entry is applied only once, when training starts.
paragraphs.zh: 探索来自两个来源。 第一个是行为层面的：降低文本 CFG 尺度会将计划拉向无条件的 VP，从而复现人类玩家的探索和恢复行为。 第二个是动作噪声（附录 B.1.1），其主要作用是让每个动作都保持一个最低概率。 那些没有或几乎没有可见效果的动作，例如在空白处点击鼠标，很容易坍缩到单一模式。 V2A 模型在其自身执行的动作上进行训练，这会导致一种自我强化的坍缩。 动作探索噪声保持一个最低的概率下限，防止任何动作被饿死。 需要注意的是，这两种探索都是双刃剑：它们使数据多样化，但也会拖慢智能体的速度并降低其达成深层子目标的机会。 因此，我们主要在智能体被认为卡住的前沿进行探索。 在每个里程碑截止时间前的最后四分钟，引导尺度以对数尺度在 7 和 0.05 之间振荡，动作噪声则开启和关闭，两者的周期均为 0.5 到 3 分钟的随机时长。 在一部分训练回合中，任务规划器也会在容易停滞的子目标上对引导尺度进行振荡（图 11）。 动作噪声仅在这些探索时期和下文的错峰进入期间应用，且 V2A 模型是在实际执行的带噪动作上训练，而不是在其预测的干净动作上训练。 在这个前沿，即使很小的噪声也足以防止自我强化的坍缩。 最后，如果所有环境同时开始它们的回合，回放数据将主要由它们当时都在处理的那个子目标主导。 为了平衡各子目标，我们将训练的开始时间错开：环境 g ∈ { 0 , … , 55 } g\in\{0,\dots,55\} 在其首个任务回合之前，先在带动作噪声的无条件世界中运行 ( g + 1 2 ) ⋅ 32 (g+\tfrac{1}{2})\cdot 32 秒（16 秒到 29.6 分钟），从而将各环境分散到任务的不同阶段。 这种错峰进入仅在训练开始时应用一次。

paragraphs.en: To save compute, a training episode is split into segments that end at four milestones read from the inventory (a crafting table, a wooden pickaxe, a stone pickaxe, and three iron ore) and a final segment that ends at the diamond. The segments have limits of 10, 10, 10, 15, and 15 minutes plus the four-minute exploration period; a missed deadline or a third death ends the episode. We also save the world when an episode reaches the stone pickaxe, keep the 14 latest save points, and start a new episode from a random save with probability 0.25 times the filled fraction of this pool. These rules are not used at evaluation. We note that these rules could tilt the training distribution through selection bias. The limits, however, are loose. During training, each limit was 1.9 to 2.8 times the mean time the agent took to reach the milestone, and at least 92% of the reached milestones came within the limit. The deadlines thus rarely cut episodes that were still making progress and are unlikely to accelerate learning the way a reward would. If anything, the tilt works against speed, as an episode nearing its deadline enters the exploration period, which slows the agent down. Even if such a positive tilt exists, the four milestones are far coarser than the 15 to 20 rewarded subgoals of RL agents ( Baker et al., 2022 ; Hafner et al., 2025b ) . For the oracle VP, we do not use the milestone deadlines and keep only a global episode limit of up to 10 minutes. The oracle is an RL policy that progresses much faster than human players, so deadlines set for our VP, which follows the pace of human gameplay, are rarely reached.
paragraphs.zh: 为节省算力，一个训练回合被拆分为若干片段，片段结束于从物品栏读取的四个里程碑（工作台、木镐、石镐和三块铁矿石），外加一个结束于钻石的最终片段。 各片段的时限分别为10、10、10、15、15分钟，外加四分钟的探索期；错过时限或第三次死亡会结束该回合。 我们还会在回合达到石镐时保存世界，保留最近的14个存档点，并以0.25乘以此存档池已填充比例的概率从一个随机存档开始新回合。 这些规则在评估时不使用。 我们指出，这些规则可能通过选择偏差使训练分布发生倾斜。 不过，这些时限较为宽松。 在训练期间，每个时限都是智能体到达该里程碑平均用时（mean time）的1.9到2.8倍，且至少92%的已达成里程碑都在时限内完成。 因此，这些截止时间很少会切断仍在取得进展的回合，也不太可能像奖励那样加速学习。 如果说有什么影响，这种倾斜反而不利于速度，因为回合临近截止时间时会进入探索期，这会拖慢智能体的速度。 即使存在这种正向倾斜，这四个里程碑也远比RL智能体的15到20个有奖励的子目标粗略（Baker et al., 2022；Hafner et al., 2025b）。 对于先知VP（oracle VP），我们不使用里程碑截止时间，只保留一个最长10分钟的全局回合时限。 先知是一个进展速度远快于人类玩家的RL策略，因此为跟随人类游戏节奏的我们的VP设定的截止时间很少会被触及。

paragraphs.en: These steps change only the video, not the game. As with the VPT recordings, the environment renders frames without a cursor and we draw ours on top, and we apply the same post-processing to the VP’s training data and to the agent’s observations during training and evaluation. The steps are needed because of the Wan2.2 VAE ( Wan Team, 2025 ) , whose latent space Cosmos3 is trained in. The VAE does not preserve small, high-precision details such as text and the cursor, which matter for computer-use tasks. With the oracle VP, which does not go through the VAE, the agent learns to mine diamonds without any of this post-processing. We therefore see the post-processing as a limitation of the Wan2.2 VAE rather than of our method, and we expect it to become unnecessary once video VAEs are trained on computer-use data.
paragraphs.zh: 这些步骤只改变视频，不改变游戏。 与 VPT 录像一样，环境渲染的帧不含光标，我们在其上绘制光标，并且我们对 VP 的训练数据以及在训练和评估期间智能体的观测应用同样的后处理。 之所以需要这些步骤，是因为 Wan2.2 VAE（Wan Team, 2025），Cosmos3 就是在其潜在空间中训练的。 该 VAE 无法保留文本和光标等小而高精度的细节，而这些细节对计算机使用任务很重要。 对于不经过 VAE 的 oracle VP，智能体无需任何此类后处理就能学会挖掘钻石。 因此，我们认为这种后处理是 Wan2.2 VAE 的局限，而非我们方法的局限，并且我们预计，一旦视频 VAE 在计算机使用数据上训练过，它就不再必要了。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on 13 DeepMind Control (DMC) tasks, four single-task OGBench environments, and seven Atari games. Each online method receives 10 6 10^{6} environment actions and is evaluated every 25,000 actions over 20 episodes, with five training seeds per task. Random-V2A collects its interaction budget before offline fitting on different-sized subsets. We average tasks equally, reporting native return on DMC, success rate on OGBench, and 100 ​ R agent / R expert 100R_{\mathrm{agent}}/R_{\mathrm{expert}} on Atari.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在13个DeepMind Control（DMC）任务、四个单任务OGBench环境和七个Atari游戏上进行评估。 每个在线方法接收 10 6 10^{6} 个环境动作，并每25,000个动作在20个回合上进行一次评估，每个任务使用五个训练种子。 Random-V2A在离线拟合前于不同规模的子集上收集其交互预算。 我们对任务进行等权平均，在DMC上报告原生回报，在OGBench上报告成功率，在Atari上报告 100 ​ R agent / R expert 100R_{\mathrm{agent}}/R_{\mathrm{expert}}。

sents.en: We evaluate on 13 DeepMind Control (DMC) tasks, four single-task OGBench environments, and seven Atari games.
sents.zh: 我们在13个DeepMind Control（DMC）任务、四个单任务OGBench环境和七个Atari游戏上进行评估。

sents.zh: 每个在线方法接收 10 6 10^{6} 个环境动作，并每25,000个动作在20个回合上进行一次评估，每个任务使用五个训练种子。

sents.zh: Random-V2A在离线拟合前于不同规模的子集上收集其交互预算。

sents.zh: 我们对任务进行等权平均，在DMC上报告原生回报，在OGBench上报告成功率，在Atari上报告 100 ​ R agent / R expert 100R_{\mathrm{agent}}/R_{\mathrm{expert}}。

paragraphs.en: We use four visual single-task environments: cube-single and cube-double require rearranging one and two cubes; scene requires manipulating a drawer, window, and locking buttons; and antmaze-large requires navigating a quadruped robot to a goal. Observations are 64 × 64 64\times 64 RGB images. We use task 2 for Cube Single, Cube Double, and Scene, and task 1 for AntMaze Large.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用四个视觉单任务环境：cube-single 和 cube-double 需要重排一个和两个立方体；scene 需要操作抽屉、窗户和锁定按钮；antmaze-large 需要控制四足机器人导航到目标位置。 观测为 64 × 64 64\times 64 的 RGB 图像。 对于 Cube Single、Cube Double 和 Scene，我们使用任务 2；对于 AntMaze Large，我们使用任务 1。

sents.en: We use four visual single-task environments: cube-single and cube-double require rearranging one and two cubes; scene requires manipulating a drawer, window, and locking buttons; and antmaze-large requires navigating a quadruped robot to a goal.
sents.zh: 我们使用四个视觉单任务环境：cube-single 和 cube-double 需要重排一个和两个立方体；scene 需要操作抽屉、窗户和锁定按钮；antmaze-large 需要控制四足机器人导航到目标位置。

sents.en: Observations are 64 × 64 64\times 64 RGB images.
sents.zh: 观测为 64 × 64 64\times 64 的 RGB 图像。

sents.en: We use task 2 for Cube Single, Cube Double, and Scene, and task 1 for AntMaze Large.
sents.zh: 对于 Cube Single、Cube Double 和 Scene，我们使用任务 2；对于 AntMaze Large，我们使用任务 1。

paragraphs.en: Following Giammarino et al. (2024) , we use 13 tasks from DMC ( Tassa et al., 2018 ) : Ball-in-Cup Catch, Finger Spin, Cartpole Balance and Swingup, Pendulum Swingup, Walker Stand/Walk/Run, Hopper Stand/Hop, Quadruped Walk/Run, and Cheetah Run. Agents receive 84 × 84 84\times 84 RGB observations with three-frame histories.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Giammarino 等人 (2024) 的做法，我们使用 DMC（Tassa 等人，2018）中的 13 个任务：Ball-in-Cup Catch、Finger Spin、Cartpole Balance 和 Swingup、Pendulum Swingup、Walker Stand/Walk/Run、Hopper Stand/Hop、Quadruped Walk/Run 以及 Cheetah Run。 智能体接收 84 × 84 84\times 84 的三帧历史 RGB 观测。

sents.en: Following Giammarino et al.
sents.zh: 遵循 Giammarino 等人

sents.en: (2024) , we use 13 tasks from DMC ( Tassa et al., 2018 ) : Ball-in-Cup Catch, Finger Spin, Cartpole Balance and Swingup, Pendulum Swingup, Walker Stand/Walk/Run, Hopper Stand/Hop, Quadruped Walk/Run, and Cheetah Run.
sents.zh: (2024) 的做法，我们使用 DMC（Tassa 等人，2018）中的 13 个任务：Ball-in-Cup Catch、Finger Spin、Cartpole Balance 和 Swingup、Pendulum Swingup、Walker Stand/Walk/Run、Hopper Stand/Hop、Quadruped Walk/Run 以及 Cheetah Run。

sents.en: Agents receive 84 × 84 84\times 84 RGB observations with three-frame histories.
sents.zh: 智能体接收 84 × 84 84\times 84 的三帧历史 RGB 观测。

paragraphs.en: Following Escontrela et al. (2023) , we evaluate on Assault, Atlantis, Boxing, Freeway, Kangaroo, Pong, and Zaxxon from the Arcade Learning Environment ( Bellemare et al., 2013 ) . We use 84 × 84 84\times 84 grayscale observations, four-frame histories, the minimal action set, sticky-action probability 0.25, and action repeat four. One million Atari decisions correspond to approximately four million emulator frames.
paragraphs.zh: 沿用 Escontrela 等人 (2023) 的做法，我们在 Arcade Learning Environment（Bellemare 等人，2013）的 Assault、Atlantis、Boxing、Freeway、Kangaroo、Pong 和 Zaxxon 上进行评估。 我们使用 84 × 84 84\times 84 的灰度观测、四帧历史、最小动作集、0.25 的粘滞动作概率以及动作重复四次。 一百万次 Atari 决策对应大约四百万个模拟器帧。

sents.en: Following Escontrela et al.
sents.zh: 沿用 Escontrela 等人

sents.en: (2023) , we evaluate on Assault, Atlantis, Boxing, Freeway, Kangaroo, Pong, and Zaxxon from the Arcade Learning Environment ( Bellemare et al., 2013 ) .
sents.zh: (2023) 的做法，我们在 Arcade Learning Environment（Bellemare 等人，2013）的 Assault、Atlantis、Boxing、Freeway、Kangaroo、Pong 和 Zaxxon 上进行评估。

sents.en: We use 84 × 84 84\times 84 grayscale observations, four-frame histories, the minimal action set, sticky-action probability 0.25, and action repeat four.
sents.zh: 我们使用 84 × 84 84\times 84 的灰度观测、四帧历史、最小动作集、0.25 的粘滞动作概率以及动作重复四次。

sents.en: One million Atari decisions correspond to approximately four million emulator frames.
sents.zh: 一百万次 Atari 决策对应大约四百万个模拟器帧。

paragraphs.en: Mirror , BCO, Grounding, and Random-V2A use flow-based action models with method-specific conditioning. Continuous-control models use an IMPALA-style visual encoder and four 1024-unit flow layers. Atari uses a smaller encoder, one 512-unit flow layer, and factorized one-hot action codes projected to legal actions. Training uses Adam with learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , batch size 256, gradient clipping at 10, and random-shift augmentation. Action sampling uses ten Euler integration steps, from zero initialization at evaluation. LAIfO uses its separate single-action learner.
paragraphs.zh: Mirror、BCO、Grounding 和 Random-V2A 使用基于流（flow）的动作模型，并采用各自方法特定的条件机制。 连续控制模型使用 IMPALA 风格的视觉编码器和四个 1024 单元的流层。 Atari 使用较小的编码器、一个 512 单元的流层，以及投影到合法动作上的分解式独热（one-hot）动作编码。 训练使用 Adam 优化器，学习率为 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4}，批次大小为 256，梯度裁剪阈值为 10，并使用随机平移数据增强。 动作采样使用十个 Euler 积分步，在评估时从零初始化开始。 LAIfO 使用其独立的单动作学习器。

sents.en: Mirror , BCO, Grounding, and Random-V2A use flow-based action models with method-specific conditioning.
sents.zh: Mirror、BCO、Grounding 和 Random-V2A 使用基于流（flow）的动作模型，并采用各自方法特定的条件机制。

sents.en: Continuous-control models use an IMPALA-style visual encoder and four 1024-unit flow layers.
sents.zh: 连续控制模型使用 IMPALA 风格的视觉编码器和四个 1024 单元的流层。

sents.en: Atari uses a smaller encoder, one 512-unit flow layer, and factorized one-hot action codes projected to legal actions.
sents.zh: Atari 使用较小的编码器、一个 512 单元的流层，以及投影到合法动作上的分解式独热（one-hot）动作编码。

sents.en: Training uses Adam with learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , batch size 256, gradient clipping at 10, and random-shift augmentation.
sents.zh: 训练使用 Adam 优化器，学习率为 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4}，批次大小为 256，梯度裁剪阈值为 10，并使用随机平移数据增强。

sents.en: Action sampling uses ten Euler integration steps, from zero initialization at evaluation.
sents.zh: 动作采样使用十个 Euler 积分步，在评估时从零初始化开始。

sents.en: LAIfO uses its separate single-action learner.
sents.zh: LAIfO 使用其独立的单动作学习器。

paragraphs.en: The action horizon K K is five on OGBench; three on DMC except Cartpole Balance (seven), Cartpole Swingup (ten), and Pendulum Swingup (twenty); and two on Atari except Atlantis and Kangaroo (four).
paragraphs.zh: 在 OGBench 上动作时域 K K 为五；在 DMC 上为三，但 Cartpole Balance（七）、Cartpole Swingup（十）和 Pendulum Swingup（二十）除外；在 Atari 上为二，但 Atlantis 和 Kangaroo（四）除外。

paragraphs.en: Experts are BRO ( Nauman et al., 2024 ) on DMC, FQL ( Park et al., 2025b ) on OGBench, and DQN ( Mnih et al., 2013 ) on Atari. BCO and LAIfO receive observation-only demonstrations: 50 episodes per Atari game and 1,000/500/500/50 episodes for Cube Single/Cube Double/Scene/AntMaze Large. On OGBench, LAIfO uses full-horizon trajectories that continue after success, whereas BCO uses the original shorter demonstrations. DMC uses 50 episodes for BCO and 100 for LAIfO. No method uses expert action labels, task rewards, or proprioceptive state.
paragraphs.zh: 专家采用的方法是：DMC 上的 BRO（Nauman et al., 2024）、OGBench 上的 FQL（Park et al., 2025b）以及 Atari 上的 DQN（Mnih et al., 2013）。 BCO 和 LAIfO 接收仅含观测的演示：每个 Atari 游戏 50 个回合，Cube Single/Cube Double/Scene/AntMaze Large 分别为 1,000/500/500/50 个回合。 在 OGBench 上，LAIfO 使用在成功之后仍继续的完整时程轨迹，而 BCO 使用原本较短的演示。 在 DMC 上，BCO 使用 50 个回合，LAIfO 使用 100 个回合。 没有任何方法使用专家动作标签、任务奖励或本体感觉状态。

sents.en: Experts are BRO ( Nauman et al., 2024 ) on DMC, FQL ( Park et al., 2025b ) on OGBench, and DQN ( Mnih et al., 2013 ) on Atari.
sents.zh: 专家采用的方法是：DMC 上的 BRO（Nauman et al., 2024）、OGBench 上的 FQL（Park et al., 2025b）以及 Atari 上的 DQN（Mnih et al., 2013）。

sents.en: BCO and LAIfO receive observation-only demonstrations: 50 episodes per Atari game and 1,000/500/500/50 episodes for Cube Single/Cube Double/Scene/AntMaze Large.
sents.zh: BCO 和 LAIfO 接收仅含观测的演示：每个 Atari 游戏 50 个回合，Cube Single/Cube Double/Scene/AntMaze Large 分别为 1,000/500/500/50 个回合。

sents.en: On OGBench, LAIfO uses full-horizon trajectories that continue after success, whereas BCO uses the original shorter demonstrations.
sents.zh: 在 OGBench 上，LAIfO 使用在成功之后仍继续的完整时程轨迹，而 BCO 使用原本较短的演示。

sents.en: DMC uses 50 episodes for BCO and 100 for LAIfO.
sents.zh: 在 DMC 上，BCO 使用 50 个回合，LAIfO 使用 100 个回合。

sents.en: No method uses expert action labels, task rewards, or proprioceptive state.
sents.zh: 没有任何方法使用专家动作标签、任务奖励或本体感觉状态。

paragraphs.en: Mirror and Grounding use task-specific latent flow predictors with four residual blocks of width 512. A spatial autoencoder with encoder widths 64,128,128,128 64,128,128,128 maps frames at their native resolution to 4 × 4 × 2 4\times 4\times 2 latents on OGBench and DMC and 7 × 7 × 2 7\times 7\times 2 latents on Atari. The predictor models normalized latent differences from the current frame. Autoencoders train for 250,000 updates and predictors for 10 7 10^{7} updates; flow training uses Adam with peak learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , cosine decay, batch size 256, gradient clipping at 1, and exponential-moving-average weights with decay 0.999, and we keep the checkpoints with the lowest validation loss. Prediction uses ten Euler steps and averages eight latent samples per predicted frame. Autoencoders are frozen during flow training, and both models remain frozen during downstream learning. Each task shares one planner checkpoint across downstream seeds. Atari planners use three context frames, while action models use four.
paragraphs.zh: Mirror 与 Grounding 使用任务专用的潜在流预测器，包含四个残差块，宽度为 512。 一个编码器宽度为 64,128,128,128 64,128,128,128 的空间自编码器，将帧在其原始分辨率上映射为 OGBench 和 DMC 上的 4 × 4 × 2 4\times 4\times 2 潜变量，以及 Atari 上的 7 × 7 × 2 7\times 7\times 2 潜变量。 预测器对相对于当前帧的归一化潜变量差进行建模。 自编码器训练 250,000 次更新，预测器训练 10 7 10^{7} 次更新；流训练使用 Adam，峰值学习率为 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4}，余弦衰减，批大小为 256，梯度裁剪为 1，并使用衰减为 0.999 的指数移动平均权重，我们保留验证损失最低的检查点。 预测使用十个欧拉步骤，并对每个预测帧平均八个潜变量样本。 自编码器在流训练期间被冻结，且两个模型在下游学习期间均保持冻结。 每个任务在多个下游种子间共享一个规划器检查点。 Atari 的规划器使用三个上下文帧，而动作模型使用四个。

sents.en: Mirror and Grounding use task-specific latent flow predictors with four residual blocks of width 512.
sents.zh: Mirror 与 Grounding 使用任务专用的潜在流预测器，包含四个残差块，宽度为 512。

sents.en: A spatial autoencoder with encoder widths 64,128,128,128 64,128,128,128 maps frames at their native resolution to 4 × 4 × 2 4\times 4\times 2 latents on OGBench and DMC and 7 × 7 × 2 7\times 7\times 2 latents on Atari.
sents.zh: 一个编码器宽度为 64,128,128,128 64,128,128,128 的空间自编码器，将帧在其原始分辨率上映射为 OGBench 和 DMC 上的 4 × 4 × 2 4\times 4\times 2 潜变量，以及 Atari 上的 7 × 7 × 2 7\times 7\times 2 潜变量。

sents.en: The predictor models normalized latent differences from the current frame.
sents.zh: 预测器对相对于当前帧的归一化潜变量差进行建模。

sents.en: Autoencoders train for 250,000 updates and predictors for 10 7 10^{7} updates; flow training uses Adam with peak learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , cosine decay, batch size 256, gradient clipping at 1, and exponential-moving-average weights with decay 0.999, and we keep the checkpoints with the lowest validation loss.
sents.zh: 自编码器训练 250,000 次更新，预测器训练 10 7 10^{7} 次更新；流训练使用 Adam，峰值学习率为 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4}，余弦衰减，批大小为 256，梯度裁剪为 1，并使用衰减为 0.999 的指数移动平均权重，我们保留验证损失最低的检查点。

sents.en: Prediction uses ten Euler steps and averages eight latent samples per predicted frame.
sents.zh: 预测使用十个欧拉步骤，并对每个预测帧平均八个潜变量样本。

sents.en: Autoencoders are frozen during flow training, and both models remain frozen during downstream learning.
sents.zh: 自编码器在流训练期间被冻结，且两个模型在下游学习期间均保持冻结。

sents.en: Each task shares one planner checkpoint across downstream seeds.
sents.zh: 每个任务在多个下游种子间共享一个规划器检查点。

sents.en: Atari planners use three context frames, while action models use four.
sents.zh: Atari 的规划器使用三个上下文帧，而动作模型使用四个。

paragraphs.en: After 5,000 random actions, Mirror repeatedly obtains K K future frames, predicts a K K -action sequence from the current visual history and these frames, and executes it before replanning. Achieved observations and executed actions enter a 100,000-transition replay buffer, with 0.2 V2A model updates per environment action. Training actions are sampled stochastically from the flow policy on all benchmarks. On OGBench and DMC, each step also adds Gaussian noise to one randomly chosen action coordinate ( σ = 0.1 \sigma=0.1 on OGBench, task-specific on DMC). Atari relies on the stochastic flow sampling alone. Evaluation uses deterministic V2A model readout without collection noise.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行 5,000 次随机动作后，Mirror 反复获取 K K 个未来帧，从当前视觉历史和这些帧预测出一个 K K 动作序列，并在重新规划之前执行该序列。 已获得的观测和已执行的动作会进入一个包含 100,000 条转移的回放缓冲区，每个环境动作对应 0.2 次 V2A 模型更新。 在所有基准上，训练动作均从流策略中随机采样。 在 OGBench 和 DMC 上，每一步还会向随机选取的一个动作坐标添加高斯噪声（在 OGBench 上 σ = 0.1 \sigma=0.1，在 DMC 上依任务而定）。 Atari 仅依赖随机流采样本身。 评估使用确定性的 V2A 模型读出，且不含采集噪声。

sents.en: After 5,000 random actions, Mirror repeatedly obtains K K future frames, predicts a K K -action sequence from the current visual history and these frames, and executes it before replanning.
sents.zh: 在执行 5,000 次随机动作后，Mirror 反复获取 K K 个未来帧，从当前视觉历史和这些帧预测出一个 K K 动作序列，并在重新规划之前执行该序列。

sents.en: Achieved observations and executed actions enter a 100,000-transition replay buffer, with 0.2 V2A model updates per environment action.
sents.zh: 已获得的观测和已执行的动作会进入一个包含 100,000 条转移的回放缓冲区，每个环境动作对应 0.2 次 V2A 模型更新。

sents.en: Training actions are sampled stochastically from the flow policy on all benchmarks.
sents.zh: 在所有基准上，训练动作均从流策略中随机采样。

sents.en: On OGBench and DMC, each step also adds Gaussian noise to one randomly chosen action coordinate ( σ = 0.1 \sigma=0.1 on OGBench, task-specific on DMC).
sents.zh: 在 OGBench 和 DMC 上，每一步还会向随机选取的一个动作坐标添加高斯噪声（在 OGBench 上 σ = 0.1 \sigma=0.1，在 DMC 上依任务而定）。

sents.en: Atari relies on the stochastic flow sampling alone.
sents.zh: Atari 仅依赖随机流采样本身。

sents.en: Evaluation uses deterministic V2A model readout without collection noise.
sents.zh: 评估使用确定性的 V2A 模型读出，且不含采集噪声。

paragraphs.en: For learned-planner experiments, we build the planner’s training set by iterative dataset aggregation: starting from 200,000 expert transitions, each round executes the current planner–V2A controller and branches 20-step expert recoveries (30 steps in later rounds for three DMC tasks) from its states with probability 0.1 per step, with later rounds adding action noise and finally a mix of action corruptions (Gaussian noise, random, scaled, sticky, or delayed actions) to the executed controller actions. The final planner is trained from scratch on the aggregated corpus (3.5–13 million transitions per task, 5% held out for validation). It conditions on three frames and predicts one future frame at a time, generating K K -frame plans autoregressively.
paragraphs.zh: 在学习型规划器实验中，我们通过迭代数据集聚合来构建规划器的训练集：从 200,000 条专家转移开始，每一轮执行当前的规划器–V2A 控制器，并以每步 0.1 的概率从其状态分支出 20 步的专家恢复（在后续轮次中对三个 DMC 任务为 30 步），后续轮次还在控制器执行的动作上添加动作噪声，最终加入多种动作破坏方式的混合（高斯噪声、随机动作、缩放动作、粘滞动作或延迟动作）。 最终的规划器在聚合语料上从头训练（每个任务 350 万至 1300 万条转移，其中 5% 留作验证）。 它以三帧为条件，一次预测一帧未来画面，并自回归地生成 K 个 K 帧计划。

paragraphs.en: BCO ( Torabi et al., 2018 ) alternates learner interaction, V2A model fitting, and policy fitting. The V2A model infers action sequences from expert observations, and an observation-conditioned policy learns these pseudo-labels and executes action chunks open loop. Both networks retain their parameters and optimizer state across rounds. Episode-level validation selects each fit, and pending fits finish before final evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: BCO（Torabi 等，2018）交替进行学习者交互、V2A 模型拟合和策略拟合。 V2A 模型从专家观测中推断动作序列，一个以观测为条件的策略学习这些伪标签并开环执行动作块。 两个网络在多轮之间都保留其参数和优化器状态。 回合级验证用于选择每次拟合，待处理的拟合会在最终评估之前完成。

sents.en: BCO ( Torabi et al., 2018 ) alternates learner interaction, V2A model fitting, and policy fitting.

paragraphs.en: LAIfO ( Giammarino et al., 2024 ) learns an imitation reward by discriminating expert and learner observation transitions, then trains a single-action off-policy learner. Transition distance n n controls discriminator inputs and critic bootstrapping. DMC uses released task-specific settings with our BRO experts; Atari uses a dueling Double-DQN ( Wang et al., 2016 ; van Hasselt et al., 2015 ) adaptation with greedy evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: LAIfO（Giammarino et al., 2024）通过判别专家与学习者的观测转移来学习一个模仿奖励，然后训练单动作的离策略学习者。 转移距离 n n 控制判别器的输入和评论家的自举。 DMC 使用已发布的任务特定设置以及我们的 BRO 专家；Atari 使用带贪婪评估的决斗 Double-DQN（Wang et al., 2016；van Hasselt et al., 2015）改编版本。

sents.en: LAIfO ( Giammarino et al., 2024 ) learns an imitation reward by discriminating expert and learner observation transitions, then trains a single-action off-policy learner.

sents.zh: 转移距离 n n 控制判别器的输入和评论家的自举。

sents.en: DMC uses released task-specific settings with our BRO experts; Atari uses a dueling Double-DQN ( Wang et al., 2016 ; van Hasselt et al., 2015 ) adaptation with greedy evaluation.

paragraphs.en: We tune exploration decay, transition distance, batch size, and a paired learning-rate/feature-dimension setting on Cube Single and Pong using 24- and 36-configuration grids, respectively, with three seeds per configuration. Selection uses performance at one million actions. Both suites select a 100k exploration decay, batch size 512, learning rate 8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5} , and feature dimension 100. Transition distance is three for OGBench and one for Atari; discriminator learning rate is 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Cube Single 和 Pong 上分别使用 24 组和 36 组配置的网格，每配置三个随机种子，对探索衰减、转移距离、批大小以及成对的学习率/特征维度设置进行调优。 选择基于一百万次动作时的性能进行。 两套实验均选择 100k 的探索衰减、512 的批大小、8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5} 的学习率以及 100 的特征维度。 OGBench 的转移距离为三，Atari 为一；判别器学习率为 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} 。

paragraphs.en: Grounding ( Luo & Du, 2024 ) trains a goal-conditioned action model from random and plan-guided rollouts. Each training segment uses its final achieved image as the goal and executed actions as targets. Following an initial random-only fitting phase, replay sampling uses 30% random and 70% guided data. On OGBench, we follow the released LIBERO implementation, conditioning the model on a single current frame, with each guided collection following a single video plan without replanning. During evaluation, we periodically replan from the latest observation, with the number of plans set by each environment’s time limit. For DMC and Atari, we use three and four frame observation histories, respectively. To accommodate their longer task horizon, we replan during both collection and evaluation after every two subgoals in oracle planner experiments and after every subgoal in generative planner experiments.
paragraphs.zh: Grounding（Luo & Du, 2024）从随机与规划引导的轨迹中训练一个目标条件动作模型。 每个训练片段以其最终达成的图像作为目标，并以执行的动作作为监督目标。 在初始的纯随机拟合阶段之后，重放采样使用 30% 的随机数据和 70% 的引导数据。 在 OGBench 上，我们沿用已发布的 LIBERO 实现，以单帧当前观测作为模型的条件输入，每次引导数据采集都遵循单一视频规划且不进行重新规划。 在评估时，我们会基于最新的观测定期重新规划，规划的数量由每个环境的时间上限决定。 对于 DMC 和 Atari，我们分别使用三帧和四帧的观测历史。 为适应其更长的任务时域，在先知规划器实验中，我们每两个子目标重新规划一次，在生成式规划器实验中，每个子目标都重新规划一次，采集和评估阶段均是如此。

paragraphs.en: We tune random-action hold duration and optimizer-update intervals between guided and random collection using 27-configuration, three-seed sweeps on Cube Single, Finger Spin, and Pong, ranked by the final five evaluations. Selected ( hold , guided interval , random interval ) (\text{hold},\text{guided interval},\text{random interval}) values are ( 5,100,500 ) (5,100,500) , ( 10,100,500 ) (10,100,500) , and ( 5,200 , 1000 ) (5,200,1000) for OGBench, DMC, and Atari, respectively. OGBench collection intervals scale with task length.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在引导式与随机式数据采集之间调整随机动作的保持时长和优化器更新间隔，在 Cube Single、Finger Spin 和 Pong 上使用 27 种配置、三个随机种子的扫描实验，并以最后五次评估结果进行排序。 针对所选的 (hold, guided interval, random interval)（保持时长、引导间隔、随机间隔）取值，OGBench、DMC 和 Atari 分别为 (5,100,500)、(10,100,500) 和 (5,200,1000)。 OGBench 的采集间隔随任务长度而扩展。

paragraphs.en: Grounding’s learned planners use the shared architecture and training recipe with task-specific subgoal targets. DMC and Atari reuse the aggregated expert/recovery corpus, conditioning on three frames to predict an expert-continuation subgoal K K actions ahead. OGBench uses 1,000 expert episodes per task with a 950/50 training/validation split, conditions on one frame, and jointly predicts 7/14/20/70 subgoals for Cube Single/Cube Double/Scene/AntMaze Large. Following the original implementation, targets are spaced evenly from a sampled starting frame to shortly after expert success, with the final frame used for unsuccessful episodes.
paragraphs.zh: Grounding 的学习型规划器采用共享的架构与训练方案，并使用针对具体任务的子目标标签。 DMC 和 Atari 复用聚合后的专家/恢复语料库，以三帧为条件来预测 K K 步之后的专家延续子目标。 OGBench 在每个任务中使用 1,000 条专家回合，并按 950/50 划分训练/验证集，以单帧为条件，为 Cube Single/Cube Double/Scene/AntMaze Large 分别联合预测 7/14/20/70 个子目标。 按照原始实现，目标从采样的起始帧到专家成功后不久之间均匀分布，对于不成功的回合则使用最后一帧。

sents.zh: Grounding 的学习型规划器采用共享的架构与训练方案，并使用针对具体任务的子目标标签。

paragraphs.en: This baseline fits the same V2A model as Mirror independently on cumulative subsets of 100k to 1M transitions from a frozen uniformly random corpus. We hold out 5% of episodes and select checkpoints by validation flow loss. Evaluation translates visual plans into action chunks using deterministic V2A readout; generative-VP results re-evaluate the same fitted models with the learned planner in place of the oracle.
paragraphs.zh: 该基线在来自冻结的均匀随机语料库的累计 10 万至 100 万条转移上，独立拟合与 Mirror 相同的 V2A 模型。 我们保留 5% 的回合作为验证集，并根据验证流损失选择检查点。 评估使用确定性 V2A 读取将视觉规划转化为动作块；generative-VP 结果用学习到的规划器替代预言机，对同一批已拟合的模型进行重新评估。

paragraphs.en: VIPER ( Escontrela et al., 2023 ) learns a generative video model from expert observations and uses observation likelihoods as an RL reward. We include it as an Atari-only likelihood-reward reference, using estimates from its published results.
paragraphs.zh: VIPER（Escontrela et al., 2023）从专家观测中学习生成式视频模型，并将观测似然用作强化学习奖励。 我们将其作为仅限雅达利（Atari）的似然奖励参考纳入，使用其已发表结果中的估计值。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 uses 60-minute episodes in which the player respawns after dying, as in VPT ( Baker et al., 2022 ) and Dreamer V4 ( Hafner et al., 2025b ) . Dreamer V3 ( Hafner et al., 2025a ) , and the PPO, Rainbow, and IMPALA results it reports, instead end each episode after 30 minutes or at the first death. Table 5 scores our self-improving agent under this protocol by cutting each of its 128 evaluation episodes at 30 minutes or at its first death, whichever comes first, which is equivalent to running them under Dreamer V3’s protocol. Among Mirror ’s 128 episodes, 48 end early by death. Mirror still leads at every milestone except cobblestone. Mirror crafts an iron pickaxe in 8.6% of episodes, against 1.7% for Dreamer V3, even though the baselines use task rewards, abstract crafting actions, and faster block breaking.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate text control in two worlds: Woodland and Camp. The worlds are designed to contain various locations of interest, such as trees, a pool, a hill, and a cave. In each world, the player starts with an iron sword, iron tools, torches, wood planks, bread, and a water bucket. We evaluate 10 episodes per text prompt. In each episode, we first make the player pan the camera left and right to observe their environment. Then it must complete each task given by the text prompt within 30 seconds. The video planner uses a classifier-free guidance scale of 7.0. We include more results on text-conditioned task guidance in Figure 14 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个世界（Woodland 和 Camp）中评估文本控制。 这些世界被设计为包含各种感兴趣的地点，例如树、水池、小山和洞穴。 在每个世界中，玩家初始拥有一把铁剑、铁制工具、火把、木板、面包和水桶。 我们对每个文本提示评估 10 个回合。 在每个回合中，我们首先让玩家左右平移摄像头以观察其周围环境。 然后，智能体必须在 30 秒内完成文本提示给出的每个任务。 视频规划器使用 7.0 的无分类器引导尺度。 我们在图 14 中提供了更多文本条件任务引导的结果。

sents.en: We evaluate text control in two worlds: Woodland and Camp.
sents.zh: 我们在两个世界（Woodland 和 Camp）中评估文本控制。

sents.en: The worlds are designed to contain various locations of interest, such as trees, a pool, a hill, and a cave.
sents.zh: 这些世界被设计为包含各种感兴趣的地点，例如树、水池、小山和洞穴。

sents.en: In each world, the player starts with an iron sword, iron tools, torches, wood planks, bread, and a water bucket.
sents.zh: 在每个世界中，玩家初始拥有一把铁剑、铁制工具、火把、木板、面包和水桶。

sents.en: We evaluate 10 episodes per text prompt.
sents.zh: 我们对每个文本提示评估 10 个回合。

sents.en: In each episode, we first make the player pan the camera left and right to observe their environment.
sents.zh: 在每个回合中，我们首先让玩家左右平移摄像头以观察其周围环境。

sents.en: Then it must complete each task given by the text prompt within 30 seconds.
sents.zh: 然后，智能体必须在 30 秒内完成文本提示给出的每个任务。

sents.en: The video planner uses a classifier-free guidance scale of 7.0.
sents.zh: 视频规划器使用 7.0 的无分类器引导尺度。

sents.en: We include more results on text-conditioned task guidance in Figure 14 .
sents.zh: 我们在图 14 中提供了更多文本条件任务引导的结果。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 evaluates transfer to unseen OGBench goals, with all methods using oracle planners for the target tasks. Our V2A model outperforms Random-V2A in three of four environments and BCO-V2A, the V2A model learned by BCO, in all four. These results suggest that video-guided exploration helps the model acquire behaviors that remain useful beyond the tasks used for data collection. Grounding achieves at most 3.8% success, suggesting that learning to translate frame-level transitions into actions supports stronger task generalization than learning a goal-conditioned policy.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 评估了向未见过的 OGBench 目标的迁移，所有方法均使用针对目标任务的 oracle 规划器。 我们的 V2A 模型在四个环境中的三个里优于 Random-V2A，并在全部四个环境中优于 BCO-V2A（即由 BCO 学习得到的 V2A 模型）。 这些结果表明，视频引导的探索有助于模型习得在数据收集所用任务之外仍然有用的行为。 Grounding 最多仅达到 3.8% 的成功率，这表明学习将帧级转换翻译为动作，比学习目标条件策略能带来更强的任务泛化能力。

sents.zh: 我们的 V2A 模型在四个环境中的三个里优于 Random-V2A，并在全部四个环境中优于 BCO-V2A（即由 BCO 学习得到的 V2A 模型）。
